m200479.――つい先日も現れた、新種の魔物。\nそれから、なんていうのか……明らかに\n普:
Just recently, a new species appeared.
And, how should I put it… there were clearly beings that weren't ordinary monsters mixed in.
m200479.――王子殿下、緊急事態です！\nはっ……すみません、会議中でしたか。:
――Prince, it's an emergency!
Uh… sorry, were you in a meeting?
m200479.……ここ最近、流星の落下地点で目撃される、\n新種の生物の報告とも一致しますね。: …That matches recent reports of new creatures seen at meteor impact sites.
m200479.……しばらくは、\n調査にかかりきりになりそうですねぇ。: …Looks like we'll be tied up with research for a while, huh?
m200479.……まぁ、そうだよね。\n王子なら「やる」って言いだすと思ったよ。: …Well, that's right. I figured you'd be the type to say “Let's do it.”
m200479.「メニュー」の「任務」から確認できますので、\n出撃前に一度目を通しておいてくだ: You can check it in the “Missions” menu, so please review it before deploying.
m200479.あっ、良かったら少し待っていただけますか？\n私も調査に同行したくて。: Ah, if it's alright, could you wait a moment? I'd like to join the investigation as well.
m200479.あら、トレシア。\n王国に来るなんて珍しい。: Oh, Trescia. It's rare to see you in the kingdom.
m200479.いいやなーんにも。\nさて、じゃあ私は調査に出かけようかな。: No, nothing at all. Well then, I think I'll head out to investigate.
m200479.うーん……新たな情報、とは言えないですね。\n今回の戦闘で得られた発見が全てです: Hmm… I can't say it's new information. All we have are the discoveries from this battle.
m200479.えっ、お嬢様にそんな危険なことさせられないよ？: Eh? I can't let you, miss, do something that dangerous.
m200479.おぉぅ……為政者が前線に出るの、\n王国だけじゃなかったんだ……。: Oh… So it wasn't just the kingdom where rulers went to the front.
m200479.これまでの、あらゆる文献をひっくり返しても、\n似たような事例も出てこない事態だ: We've turned over every document we have, and still nothing similar shows up—it's a completely unprecedented situation.
m200479.ご近所だからね、色々知ってるよ。\n人間の生存圏における北限、\n魔物から北の大:
It's close by, so I know a lot about it.
It's the northernmost limit of human settlement, the key stronghold defending the great northern nation from monsters.
m200479.さらに、調査に同行してくれたユージェン様が、\n索敵時に不審な魔物を見つけたので: Moreover, Yuugen, who accompanied the survey, spotted a suspicious monster during scouting—
m200479.そいつらは、背後に黒く発光する円環を浮かべていた。\n天使の輪にも似ているけど、:
They had a black, glowing ring hovering behind them.
It resembled an angel's halo, but felt far more alien.
m200479.そう言うと思ったよ。\nじゃあ、作戦を立てようか。:
I thought you'd say that.
Then, let's devise a plan.
m200479.そして破壊衝動を刺激しまくる、\n恐怖の黒いわっかの可能性もあるっと。: And it could even be a terrifying black ring that constantly fuels destructive urges.
m200479.その事象のひとつが新種の魔物であり、\nもうひとつが、「黒い光冠の魔物」ってこと: One of those phenomena is a new species of monster, and the other is the “Black Light Crown monster,” right?
m200479.それから、緊急での出撃になりますから、\n「出撃コストの時間経過での回復」などの: Also, because this is an emergency sortie, there's a high chance we won't get full supplies—things like the usual recovery of sortie cost over time may not apply.
m200479.それじゃあ、３部隊すべての指揮を王子に任せるけど、\n絶対に無理はしないって約束: Then we'll leave command of all three squads to you, Prince, but promise you won't push yourself beyond your limits.
m200479.そんなに慌てて、何があったのですか？\nオーシェンさんには、\n北方の流星落下地:
Why the rush? What happened?
We'd asked Oshen to investigate the meteor-fall site up north…
m200479.ただ……未知の敵が出現する可能性が高い。\n緊急事態に対応するには、\n王子の判: But… there's a strong chance an unknown enemy will show up. To deal with an emergency, I'd like to consult your judgment, Prince—
m200479.というわけで、父からは、\nしばらく王国に出向し、\n今回の件の調査を進めるよう: So my father told me to be dispatched to the kingdom for a while and continue investigating this matter.
m200479.はい、現在北部城塞は\n多数の魔物による侵攻を受けています。: Yes, the northern fortress is currently under invasion by countless monsters.
m200479.ほぼ確実である、といえることは、\n先日の流星群の落下地点を中心に、\n様々な事: What we can say with near certainty is that various phenomena have been occurring around the meteor shower impact site from the other day—
m200479.まさにそのことでご報告が。\n皆さんは、北の大国の北部城塞をご存知でしょうか？:
I've got a report on exactly that.
Do you all know the northern fortress of the great northern nation?
m200479.また、特殊な条件下で戦闘を完遂すると、\n報奨を獲得できる『特別任務』も、\n北: Moreover, if we complete battles under special conditions, we can earn rewards from a “Special Mission” proposed by the northern great nation's merchant guild.
m200479.よし、それじゃあ急いで北部城塞に向かおう。\n緊急大総力戦、開始だ！: Alright, then let's hurry to the northern fortress. Emergency Grand Total War, commence!
m200479.よし、それなら編成単位は\n『大総力戦』形式がふさわしいかな。\n部隊ごと前線を: Alright, then the formation should follow a “Grand Total War” format. We'll rotate each squad to the front line and gear up for a long-term fight.
m200479.ん、何か分かったことがあるの？\n情報があるなら少しでも知りたいなぁ！: Hmm, have you found anything? If you have any info, I'd love to hear even a little!
m200479.アンナ、遠征の準備を。\n北の大国を救いに行く。:
Anna, prepare the expedition.
We're going to save the great northern nation.
m200479.一体何なんだろうねぇ、あのわっか。: I wonder what that halo actually is.
m200479.一方で、北部の魔物も\n辺境伯の軍との激突を避けるためか、\n小規模な襲撃しかし: On the other hand, the northern monsters have only launched small raids, probably to avoid clashing with the frontier count's army.
m200479.先日のお礼を兼ねての表敬訪問です。\nそれから、北部城塞で進めている、\n「黒い: I'm here on a courtesy visit to thank you for the other day, and also to share the progress on our investigation of the “Black Light Crown monsters” at the northern fortress.
m200479.北の大国でも武闘派で有名な\n辺境伯が治める領地ですね。\nえっ、あの、もしかし:
It's the domain ruled by the frontier count, famous for his martial prowess in the northern nation.
Wait—could something have happened at the northern fortress…!?
m200479.北部城塞の領主は、\n最前線で戦えるように教育されるんです。\n兵士に混じって最: The lords of the northern fortress are trained to fight on the front lines. They were raised to battle alongside the soldiers.
m200479.北部城塞より北側の調査は、\n今まで行われてこなかった。\n何しろ、人間が生きて:
No one's ever surveyed north of the fortress.
After all, it's not an environment humans can survive in.
m200479.報告内容から推測するに、\nかなりの長期戦を覚悟しないといけない。\n何しろ北限:
Based on the report, we should brace for a long war.
After all, we have no idea how many monsters inhabit the northern limits.
m200479.王子殿下、王国のみなさん、\nこれからよろしくお願いします♪: Prince, everyone in the kingdom, I look forward to working with you all♪
m200479.現状では、あれが良いものなのか、\n悪いものなのかも分からないかな。: At this point, we don't even know if it's good or bad.
m200479.生物の成長を早める夢の物質である可能性もあるし、\n新たな生命を芽吹かせる、\n: It might be a dream-like substance that speeds up growth, or perhaps it's a cradle of life that spawns new beings.
m200479.若だけ最前線にでっぱなしなんて、\nさすがに負担をかけすぎじゃないかい？: Having only the youngsters constantly on the front line would be too much of a burden, don't you think?
m200479.部隊には「援軍要請」のスキルを持つ者や、\nワルキューレ等の編成を忘れないように: Make sure each squad includes someone with the “Request Reinforcement” skill, and don't forget to field units like Valkyries.
m200479.高頻度で吹雪が続く気候だし、\n無数の魔物の群れが棲息している。\n調査をしよう:
The climate is plagued by constant blizzards, and endless hordes of monsters dwell there.
Even if we tried to investigate, the damage would far outweigh any benefit.
m200479.魔物の襲撃はこれまでも散発的に発生していたのですが、\n今回の規模は、前例のない: Monster raids have happened sporadically before, but this time the scale is unprecedented…
m200479.（まぁ、でも……学者にふさわしくない、\n個人的な感想だけど……）: (Well… this is just a personal thought, not exactly scholarly…)
m200479.（秩序ある神の時代が終わった……。\nじゃあその次の時代は――なんてね）: (The age of orderly gods has ended… So the next age—just kidding.)

m200521.……撤退が最善ということは余も理解している。\nだが、これ以上民に故郷を捨てさせ:
……I understand that retreat is the best option.
But I can't let the people abandon their homeland any further──
m200521.……曹操殿はどう思う？: …Lord Cao Cao, what do you think?
m200521.──さて、まず現状のおさらいを始めよう。: —Now, let's start by reviewing the current situation.
m200521.ああ、それなのだけど提案いいかしら？\n戦線を下げず、四凶を討つ方法について。:
Right, may I make a suggestion?
A way to defeat the Four Evils without pulling back the front.
m200521.あのぉ、徐華様や伏綺様に今回も頼るというのは……？: Um, relying on Xu Hua and Fu Qi again this time…?
m200521.お久しぶりですね、王国の皆様方。\nこの関雲長、遅ればせながら参上しました。:
Long time no see, everyone of the kingdom.
I, Kan'u the General, have finally arrived, albeit late.
m200521.こっちは夏侯惇と夏侯淵、\n私の手勢の中でも最高戦力の二人よ。: Here are Xiahou Dun and Xiahou Yuan, the two strongest of my forces.
m200521.さあ、勝利のための軍議を始めましょうか。: Now then, shall we begin the council for victory?
m200521.しかし、ここに登場したのが四凶。\n渾沌・窮奇・梼兀・饕餮という名の、\n華の国: But then the Four Evils appeared—the Chaos, Qiuqi, Taowu, and Taotie, the four great beasts long spoken of in the Flower Kingdom.
m200521.しかし、今の我々にはその問題に対する解決策がある。: However, we do have a solution to that problem.
m200521.そ、そうですねー。\nやっぱり帰還用の門の準備には時間が……。: Y-yes, indeed. Preparing the return gate takes time…
m200521.そう、この華の国を三度滅亡寸前に追い詰めた悪神。\nあの徐華・伏綺と死闘を繰り広: Yes, the evil god of water who drove this kingdom to the brink of extinction three times. He's the one who fought a deadly battle against Xu Hua and Fu Qi.
m200521.それでも、全員ここで死ぬよりはマシだ。\n戦線を少し下げるだけで天然の要害がある: Still, it's better than everyone dying here. If we pull back a bit, there's natural terrain that's defensible, and we can handle the Four Evils there without issue.
m200521.それでも十分すぎるほどだ。感謝する。: Even so, that's more than enough. Thank you.
m200521.それにさ、これからは人の時代なんだろう？\n頼るとしても最後の最後だけにするべき: Besides, isn't this supposed to be the age of humans now? If we do rely on them, it should only be as a last resort.
m200521.それはやめておいた方が良いんじゃないかな。\n伏綺様は復活したて、徐華様は儀式で: I think we should avoid that. Fu Qi just revived, and Xu Hua just used his power in a ritual. They're not at full strength; losing while they're weakened would be disastrous.
m200521.つまり、私たちに軍の指揮権を預けたいと？\n当然、それが難しいことは理解している: So you want to entrust us with command of the army? Of course you understand how difficult that is.
m200521.で、この子が我が軍の筆頭軍師ね。: And this child is the chief strategist of my army.
m200521.でも、私たちが加わったところでどうにかなるのかしら？\n聞いた話だと、大侵攻と呼: But even if we join, will it make a difference? From what I've heard, it's a war on the scale of a great invasion.
m200521.はーい、王子くん！ 元気してたー！？: Hey there, Prince! You doing okay!?
m200521.ふふっ、責めているわけではないから安心なさい。\n王子やアンナたちのいない王国で: Hehe, I'm not blaming you, so don't worry. There's no reason to kill time in a kingdom without the Prince or Anna, so I, Cao Mengde, will lend you my strength for my comrades.
m200521.もちろん、私たちの身の安全を最優先させてもらうけどね？: Of course, as long as you prioritize our safety first, okay?
m200521.もちろん曹操殿はかなりの傑物だとお見受けするが、\n見ず知らずの相手に兵士たちが: Of course I recognize Lord Cao Cao is a remarkable figure, but whether strangers' soldiers will obey is another matter.
m200521.了解した、誅子。皆もそれで良いな？: Understood, Zhuzi. Everyone, is that alright with you?
m200521.今は席を外しているけど私の従妹の曹仁、\n華侖のことは王子もよく知っているわよね: My cousin Cao Ren is away at the moment, but you know a lot about Hualun, don't you, Prince?
m200521.以上を前提に、これからの対応を協議したい。: With that as background, let's discuss our next steps.
m200521.余の名は誅子、この華の国の王だ。\n先の戦における助力、深く感謝申し上げる。\n: My name is Zhuzi, king of this blossoming land. I deeply appreciate your assistance in the previous battle. Thanks to you, Lord Cao, my neck is still attached.
m200521.元々しばらくこちらに滞在するつもりだったもの。\nそうよね、グリム？: I was planning to stay here for a while anyway. Right, Grimm?
m200521.元の世界では覇王をやらせてもらっていたわ。: In my original world, I was a hegemon.
m200521.冗談……ではなさそうだな。むしろ納得の風格だ。: Joke… doesn't seem like it. Actually, it has a convincing air.
m200521.撤退に一票、我々はもう六つの砦を放棄している。\n下手に粘るより後退して防備を万: I vote to retreat; we've already abandoned six forts. It's better to fall back and fortify than to stubbornly hold on. Fortunately, the locals are evacuating smoothly.
m200521.改めて自己紹介から始めましょうかしら。\n私は曹孟徳、魏王──と言っても分からな: Shall we start with a proper introduction? I'm Cao Mengde, King of Wei—though you probably don't get that. The Prince over there is a comrade I've fought alongside on the battlefield a few times.
m200521.明日の十万を救うため、今日の百を切り捨てようと、\nその痛みを抱え続けながら選択:
To save a hundred today so that a hundred thousand may live tomorrow,
we must keep bearing that pain and make the choice over and over──
m200521.曹操殿、夏侯惇殿に夏侯淵殿、荀彧殿に楽進殿か。: Lord Cao, Lord Xiahou Dun, Lord Xiahou Yuan, Lord Xun Yu, and Lord Rakushin.
m200521.曹操殿のおかげで各地の兵を呼び集める時間ができた。\n問題は、それを率いる将の数: Thanks to Lord Cao Cao, we've managed to find time to gather troops from across the lands. The problem is we don't have enough commanders to lead them.
m200521.最後に楽進。\n真面目で優秀ないい子だけど、\n怒らせると怖いから気を付けなさい: Lastly, Rakushin. He's a serious, talented good kid, but beware—make him angry and he'll be scary.
m200521.本来、単体であればボクたちの敵じゃない。\n問題は四凶の動きが完全に統制されてい: Normally a single one isn't a threat to us. The problem is their movements are perfectly coordinated. Behind them is the mastermind—that's the true villain—
m200521.楽文謙です、よろしくお願いします。: I'm Rakubun Ken, pleased to meet you.
m200521.正直に言って、議論の余地があるのかしら。\n戦線の後退以外に採れる選択肢があると: To be honest, I doubt there's any room for debate. Are you suggesting there's an option other than pulling back?
m200521.民の血と命に報いる方法は一つ、国を守ることのみ。: There is only one way to repay the blood and lives of the people: protect the nation.
m200521.気にしないで、行き掛けの駄賃のようなものよ。\n友人が困っていたら助けるのは当然: Don't mention it, it's just a little token of gratitude. When a friend is in trouble, helping them is only natural, right?
m200521.烏丸に奪われた土地は絶対に元の姿では戻らない。\n多くの民に生活を捨てさせること: The lands taken by Karasuma will never return to their former state. It will force many people to abandon their lives…
m200521.烏丸を圧倒せしめたその力を見込んで頼みがある。\nどうか我らの戦いに力を貸しても: Seeing the power that overwhelmed Karuma, I have a request. Could you lend us your strength in this battle?
m200521.王が民に尽くすのではないわ、民が王に尽くすの。\n貴女の苦痛、貴女の献身、それ自:
A king doesn't serve the people; the people serve the king.
Your pain, your devotion—they mean nothing on their own.
Self-sacrifice blinded by guilt is actually a harmful thing.
m200521.異世界からいきなり呼び出された貴女方に対し、\nこんなことを頼める筋合いではない: I know we were summoned from another world just now, so I shouldn't be asking this…
m200521.発端は烏丸による華の国への大侵攻。\n王国軍、そして異世界からの援軍もあり、\n: It all began with Karasuma's massive invasion of the Flower Kingdom. With the kingdom's forces and reinforcements from another world, we managed to repel it.
m200521.私は言ったはずよ、後ろは任せなさいってね。: I told you, leave the rear to me.
m200521.荀彧、字を文若と申します。以後お見知りおきを。: I am Xun Yu, courtesy name Wenruo. Please remember me.
m200521.誅子、貴女が罪を抱えていることは知っている。\nその後悔を胸に善き王であろうと努:
Zhuzi, I know you bear guilt.
I also know you strive to be a good king with that remorse in your heart.
But you completely misunderstand what a king is.
m200521.贖罪ごっこがしたいのなら今すぐ王の座を降りなさい！: If you want to play at atonement, step down from the throne right now!
m200521.関羽さんに、孫策さん！？ どうしてここに！？: Kan'u-san and Sun Ce-san!? Why are you both here!?
m200521.（姉妹か……青い方は見るからに隙が無いが、\n底知れない威圧感があるのは隻眼の方: Sisters… the blue one looks flawless, but the one-eyed one exudes an unfathomable intimidation.

m300307.――あ、それからついでに、\n僕の肩慣らしにも付き合ってくれたまえよ。: "—Ah, and while I'm at it, do me a favor and keep me company for a bit of practice."
m300307.――あの御方は、人間に焦がれてしまったのですわ。\nそれゆえに、始祖たる者の最後:
—She had fallen into a longing for humanity.
And so, at the very end of her existence as an Ancestor,
she attempted to create a daughter in human form.
m300307.――あの槍、グングニルって\nスルーズのお父さんの槍なんでしょ？\n返してほしい:
――That spear, Gungnir,
isn't it Thrud's father's spear?
Don't you want it back or anything?
m300307.――おや、これは困ったな。\nトラムに用事があったんだけど、\nまさかこんな戦場:
??? : ――Oh my, this is a predicament.
I had business with Tram,
but I didn't expect to find her in the middle of a battlefield.
m300307.――さぁ、早くキメリエス様を呼び出すんだ！: ――Well then, hurry up and summon Chimera!

――So, Hu-Long-chan.
How did you feel about participating in the parade?
m300307.――その後のお茶が、あたたかいです。: ――and the tea afterward was so warm.

??? : Your understanding is... somewhat incorrect.

m300307.――つまり、統率者がいる、ということですか？: So... does that mean there's a commander?
m300307.――て、敵襲！ 敵襲！！\nアンデッドの大群が村の外に迫っています！！:
—E-enemy! Enemy attack!!
A massive horde of undead is closing in from outside the village!!
m300307.――どうやら、腕は衰えていないようだね、トラム。\nむしろその人間たちに出会って:
??? : ――It seems your skills haven't dulled, Tram.
If anything, meeting these humans
has made you even sharper and fiercer.
m300307.――はい、満員御礼、拍手喝采、くらうそらす♪\nさぁトラムさま、元気よくどうぞ！:
――Yes, a full house, cheers and applause, clau-solas~♪
Now then, Tram-sama, please begin with some energy!
m300307.――へぇ、アトナテスさんにも師匠がいたんですね。: ――Huh, so Atnates had a master, too?
m300307.――エマ、私の助力は必要ありませんの？: ――Ema, do you not need my assistance?
m300307.――ディアナ、これはもう、\n王国の風物詩のようなものなのです。:
――Diana, this has become
something of a royal tradition by now.
m300307.――人の子でありながら、\nよくもここまで耐えるものだ。: ??? : —To be a mortal and yet endure this long...
m300307.――僕自身もオリュンポスの連中に狙われていてね。\n連中は僕が受け継いだ、鍛冶神:
"—I was being targeted by the bunch from Olympus.
They were after the God of Smithing's weapons that I inherited."
m300307.――外壁が突破された！\nアンデッドの群れが来るぞ！:
—The outer wall has been breached!
A horde of undead is coming!
m300307.――良い覚悟だけど、もう大丈夫よ。\nあなたたち憧れの、王子殿下を連れてきたわ。:
—That's a fine resolve, but you're safe now.

Tactical Instructor...!

m300307.日々裏方で王都を支えるその姿に、\n隠れファンも多いというケラウノスさまの依代さ:
Keranos' Vessel, who supports the capital from behind the scenes every day!
Rumor has it she has many hidden fans!
It's a life-sized doll of her!
m300307.普通はこんな太陽が出てる時間から、\nアンデッドが活動することはないものね。: It's unusual for the undead to be active while the sun is still up.
m300307.最初の血族たるあの御方は、\n自分の似姿として、\n幾人かの始祖たる血族を生み出:
That venerable one, the First of the Blood,
created several of the Ancestral Bloodlines
as reflections of herself.
m300307.最後に大事なルールを伝えよう。\nトラムさま、\nズルして両方選んだらどうなるか:
Finally, I'll share an important rule.
Tram-sama,
tell them what happens if someone cheats and picks both!
m300307.武具には心が宿るものさ。\n影打ちとてそれは同じ、今のあなたへの贈り物だ。:
"Weapons are said to house a spirit.
A shadow is no different. Consider this a gift for the person you are now."
m300307.気を落とさないで。\n私が隣で、王子を支えていくから！:
Don't be discouraged.
I'll be right here to support you, Prince!
m300307.無論だとも。\n始祖殿の頼みを断るはずもないだろう。:
Naturally.
We would never refuse a request from the Ancestor.
m300307.物質界との間にはケラウノス様が築いた、\nふたつの世界を隔てる障壁があったし――: "There was the barrier between our worlds, built by Keraunos, and—"
m300307.王子、あの者の穢れた血は、\n無数の血の使い魔を生み出し続けます。:
Prince, that being's impure blood
continues to spawn countless blood familiars.
m300307.王子、これだけのアンデッドが\n一斉に村を襲うからには、何か理由があるはずだ。: For the undead to attack the village in such numbers at once, there must be a reason behind it.
m300307.王子、それでは参りましょう。\n全速前進、よ、ヨーソローです！:
Prince, let's head out then.
Full speed ahead, here we go!
m300307.王子、それでは騒ぎも収束したことですし、\n本日はこれで帰りましょう。お疲れ様で: Prince, now that the commotion has settled, let's head back for today. Good work.
m300307.王子、アルヴァは模擬戦だろうと、\n全力全開でぶつかってくる人よ！\n不用意に受:
"Prince, Alva fights with his all, even in a sparring match!
Be careful not to accept his challenge carelessly!"
m300307.王子、不正行為をはたらくなんて、\nそんなに私の剣を見たいのかしら？:
Prince, trying to cheat like that,
do you really want to see my sword?
m300307.王子、僕もキミの旅に同行していいかな？\nなに、衣食住と美味しいおやつと、\n強:
Prince, may I join you on your journey?
Just provide me with food, shelter,
and some delicious snacks, and I'll be happy.
m300307.王子、戦闘準備を。\nここで天界兵を止めるわよ！:
Prince, prepare for battle.
We'll stop the Celestial soldiers right here!
m300307.王子ならきっと大丈夫よ。\n慎重に、慎重に……。:
I'm sure you'll be fine, Prince.
Carefully, carefully……
m300307.知り合いも何も、彼女がさっき話していた、\nアトナテスの師匠で、英傑のひとりで―:
"Know him"? He's the one I was just talking about—
Atnates's master, one of the Heroes, and—
m300307.確か、千年戦争の後に、\nなすべき事があるから、\nと言い残して天界に戻ってしま:
If I recall correctly, she said she had something to do
after the Millennium War,
and then returned to the Celestial Realm…
m300307.確かこの戦闘の時には、\nコヨミさんの生命力を贄として、\n酒呑童子を召喚されて:
If I remember correctly, during this battle,
Koyomi's life force was used as a sacrifice,
and Shuten-doji was summoned...
m300307.神聖騎士団……かつては敬虔な騎士修道会だったとか。\nそれが今や、信者を生ける鎧:
The Holy Knights…… they were once a devout knightly order, I hear.
Now, though, they've become a cult
that turns their followers into living armor.
m300307.私が皆の前でパレードに出たら、\n王子殿下も楽しい気分になりますか？:
If I march in the parade in front of everyone…
will it make the Prince happy?
m300307.私の力を解放すれば、\nアルヴァの攻撃もしのげるはずよ。\n指揮はあなたに委ねる:
"If I release my power, I should be able to withstand his attacks.
I'll leave the command to you. Good luck!"
m300307.結構難しい問題もあったのにね。\nぼくも迷っちゃったし……。:
Some of those questions were pretty tough.
Even I was torn on a few of them……
m300307.続いて第２問！\n次の問題は……これよ！:
Next up, Question 2!
The next problem is…… this one!
m300307.聖域の盗掘――じゃなかった、発掘に危険はつきもの。\n宝玉が「赤く」光った時には:
Looting the Sanctuary— no, excavating it— is always dangerous.
When the gem glows “red,”
you have to flee immediately, or it's dangerous.
m300307.英雄王にべったりだったこの男が、\n今や我が子を見るような目で\n王国軍を見つめ:
This man, who used to be glued to the Hero King,
now looks at the Kingdom's army
with the eyes of a father watching his son. People do change, don't they?
m300307.謙虚なところが可愛いです！\n市民一同、とっても感謝しています！:
Your humility is so cute!
All the citizens are very grateful!
m300307.鍛冶神を殺したあいつらに、\n一発――いや、万発の武具を叩き込んでやりたいし、\:
I want to smash a thousand weapons
into those who killed the God of Smithing.
And there should be plenty of witnesses to that moment.
m300307.長女の余裕、と言うべきでしょうか。\nけれど食いしん坊なところもあって、\nとっ:
I suppose it's the composure of an eldest daughter.
But she's also quite the foodie,
which makes her incredibly adorable, don't you think?
m300307.間に合わせの外壁でしたから、仕方ありません。\n村内のバリケード展開は間に合いま:
It was a makeshift wall, so that's to be expected.
We managed to set up the barricades in the village,
but I'm not sure how long we can hold them off...
m300307.間違いない、この襲撃の背後には、\n誇りを捨ててまでこんな戦法を取るほどに、\n:
It's certain. Behind this assault stands an existence that hates us so fiercely
it would abandon its pride to employ such tactics.
m300307.騒ぎと聞いて駆けつけてみれば亡霊同士の喧嘩とはな。\n水兵と海賊の仲の悪さには、:
I heard the commotion and came running, only to find a quarrel between the dead.
It seems the bad blood between sailors and pirates transcends both time and the grave.
m300307.魔神ウェパルの像……なんて不気味なものを……。\nあいつら、こんなものを信仰して:
A statue of the demon god Wepar... What an unsettling sight...
Did they really worship something like this?
m300307.黙れ、エマ。\n貴様にこの苦しみが分かるとでも言うのか。:
Silence, Ema.
Do you think you comprehend this suffering?

m400178.あ、残念だけど敵を倒してもＥＸＰやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはでき: Unfortunately, you won't earn any EXP, gold, or drops from this, so keep that in mind.
m400178.あぁ言い忘れてた。この映像は魔術が切れたら自動的に\n消滅するから。: Oh, I almost forgot—this illusion will vanish automatically once the magic ends.
m400178.あらなによその顔。何か言いたげじゃないの。\nあぁ、私に触れようとしたって無駄よ: Oh, what a strange face you have. You look like you've got something to say. Ah, but trying to touch me is useless, you know?
m400178.これは魔術で見せてる映像だから、\n本物じゃないの。ざーんねん♪: This is just an illusion created by magic, not the real thing. Too bad♪
m400178.さて、今日ここに来たのは是非とも不死者の\n強さを教えてあげようと思ったの。\n: So, I brought you here today to show you the true strength of the undead. Think of it as a little… training exercise.
m400178.それじゃ『大討伐ミッション』を開始するわ。\nくくっ……。せいぜいあがいたらいい: Alright, let's begin the Grand Annihilation Mission. Heh… just do your best to struggle.
m400178.まず大討伐ミッションは『敵を撃破すること』\nそれだけが目的なの。: First off, the only objective is to slay the enemies.
m400178.ライフが０になってもクリアになるわ。\nそれまでに倒した敵の数がカウントされて\: Even if your life hits zero, the mission counts as cleared. The number of enemies you've slain will be tallied as your result.
m400178.今回は敵を倒すことだけを目的とした\n『大討伐ミッション』っていう演習方式を\n: We'll be running a “Grand Annihilation Mission,” where the sole goal is to defeat the enemy.
m400178.命というはかないものを大切にしているあなたたちの\nような脆弱な存在が、不死者に: If fragile mortals like you, who cherish the fleeting nature of life, truly believe you can beat the undead, then prove it to me.
m400178.大討伐ミッションは、通常のミッションと\nちょっと違うところがあるから注意をする: The Grand Annihilation Mission works a bit differently from a normal mission, so pay attention.
m400178.実際の私にはなーんにも聞こえないから、\n大人しく話を聞くほうが得策よ。: The real me can't hear a thing, so you'd be wiser to just listen.
m400178.数百体もの不死者たちが王国に攻め入るとどうなるでしょうね。\nあなたたちに止める: Imagine what would happen if hundreds of undead poured into the kingdom. Do you think you can stop them?
m400178.理解できた？\nそれじゃあ、今回の演習に関して説明してあげる。: Got it? Then let me explain today's exercise.
m400178.私ってば親切でしょう？\nすでに王国を攻める軍隊を用意しているわ。: I'm being kind, aren't I? I've already prepared an army to assault the kingdom.
m400178.私はメトゥス。\n死霊術を極めた存在ってところかしら。: I'm Metus—master of necromancy, if you will.
m400178.自軍の被害を抑えるよりも\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかっていうのが\n重要ってこと♪: It's not about minimizing your own losses; it's all about how many foes you can bring down.

m400324.――うぉおおおおっ！！\nさすが王子！ さすが現チャンプだぜ！！\nよぉし、そう:
——Woohoo!!
As expected, Prince! As expected of the current champ!!
Alright, now that it's decided, let me explain the rules!
m400324.……おや、あんまり乗り気じゃないみたいだね。\nしかし参加しないとなると困るな…:
…Hmm, you don't seem that enthusiastic.
But it'd be a problem if you don't take part...
m400324.『多くの敵を撃破すること』が重要で、\nライフが０になってもクリアした事になり、: The goal is to defeat as many enemies as possible; even if your life hits zero, it's counted as cleared, and the number you defeat is recorded as your result.
m400324.『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ奴とか、\nワルキューレを出撃メンバーに\n入れておく: Having someone with the 'Call Reinforcements' skill, or putting a Valkyrie in your deployment team, might be useful.
m400324.あたしはあんたの強さをよく知ってるけど、\nそうじゃない奴らがどんな噂をたてるか:
I know how strong you are, but you never know what rumors the others will spread,
so you can't be too sure.
m400324.いったいどうしたんだい、ドゥーラ。\nそんなに焦らなくても王子はどこへも行かない:
What on earth is wrong, Doula?
Even if you panic, the Prince isn't going anywhere.
m400324.えーっとあとは、そうだ！\n魔界武術大会会場には、魔界の瘴気は入ってこない。\n: Uh, that's right! The tournament arena is sealed off from any demonic miasma, so you can fight with your full, unfiltered power!
m400324.そ、そっか、現チャンプは王子だからな！\nうぉおおおっ、タイトル防衛戦ッ！\n熱:
I-I see, the current champ is you, Prince!
Woohoo, a title defense!!
It's hot! So hot...!!
m400324.そ、それにっ！ せっかく数多の猛者と戦える、\nこんな貴重な機会を逃す手はないよ:
A-and also! This is a rare chance to fight countless warriors,
we can't just let it slip away, right? Right?
m400324.それから今回の魔界武術大会では、\n出撃コストが時間経過で回復しないことも\nし: Also, remember that in this tournament, deployment cost doesn't recover over time.
m400324.それから敵を倒しても、EXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることは出来ない: And even if you defeat enemies, you won't get EXP, gold, or any drops.
m400324.だ、だけど……！！\nチャンプ、本当に大事件なんだよ！！\nなんと、魔界武術大会:
B-but...!!
Champ, it's really a huge event!!
Believe it or not, the Demon Realm Martial Arts Tournament has been decided!
m400324.だから現チャンプらしく、傷つくことを恐れず、\n少しでも多くの挑戦者を倒すことを: So, like a true champ, don't fear getting hurt—just try to take down as many challengers as you can!
m400324.へぇ、また魔界武術大会が開かれるのかい。\n――ということは王子、\n今回はタイ:
Huh, another Demon Realm Martial Arts Tournament, huh.
—so that means, Prince,
this time it's a title defense match.
m400324.やれやれ、楽しみ過ぎてから回っちゃってるね。\nさて王子、もちろん参加するんだろ:
Good grief, you're getting all worked up.
Now then, Prince, you're joining, right?
m400324.よぉーし、気合入ってきた！\nそれじゃあ王子、魔界武術大会に出発だ！！: Alright, I'm fired up! Then, Prince, off to the Demonic Martial Arts Tournament!!
m400324.多数の敵と相対する『大討伐ミッション』は\nもちろん知ってるよな？\n今回も基本:
You know the 'Massive Hunt Mission' where you face many enemies, right?
This time's basics are the same.
m400324.王子はチャンプとして、\n向かってくる多数の挑戦者を、\nばったばったとなぎ倒さ:
As the champ, Prince, you have to sweep away the hordes of challengers
that come at you.
m400324.魔界武術大会は名誉ある武の舞台。\nそれを現チャンプが辞退したとなると、\n王子:
The Demon Realm Martial Arts Tournament is an honorable stage of combat.
If the current champ backs out, it would tarnish not only your honor but also that of your comrades.

m400398.『大討伐ミッション』は、\n一体でも多くの敵を倒す事が目的です。: The goal of a Grand Annihilation Mission is to take down as many foes as possible.
m400398.いやー、大変な事になりましたねぇ。\nもうドレスお披露目会の本番直前だっていうの: Wow, this has turned into a real mess. The dress showcase is supposed to be right before the main event.
m400398.さっき見てきましたけど、お父さん、\n物凄い剣幕でしたよ。娘たちは絶対に渡さん！: I just saw him—he was furious. He swore he'd never hand over his daughters! And if the Prince steps out, he'll make him his sworn enemy.
m400398.しかし、誤解を解き事態を収拾するためには、\n王子本人による説明が必要不可欠です: Still, the only way to clear up the misunderstanding is for the Prince himself to explain. I suspect it could easily turn into a battle…
m400398.では王子、『大討伐ミッション』の発令を！: Then, Prince, issue the Grand Annihilation Mission!
m400398.なにぶん、お披露目会を見に来ている観客たちも多く、\n普段のような部隊展開を行う: Since a large crowd has gathered to watch the showcase, we can't deploy our troops as freely as usual.
m400398.はい……。まさか、\n金糸雀姉妹のお父様がジューンブライドの祝祭を\n本物の結婚: Yes… I never imagined the Goldfinch sisters' father would mistake the June Bride festival for an actual wedding and storm in.
m400398.また、敵を倒してもEXPやゴールドを\n入手出来ない点にも気を付けて下さい。: Also, note that defeating enemies won't grant any EXP or gold.
m400398.レナータさんからの報告によると、金糸雀姉妹や\n父親に加え、多数の妖怪たちが集ま: According to Renata's report, the Goldfinch sisters, their father, and a host of youkai have all gathered. We should be fully prepared.
m400398.一触即発な親子喧嘩って雰囲気でしたからねぇ。\nなんか、妖怪たちも集まり始めてて: It feels like a powder-keg family feud. Plus, all those youkai are gathering, so a simple talk probably won't settle this.
m400398.出撃コストが時間経過では回復しないため、\nスキル『援軍要請』を持つメンバーや、: Because deployment cost doesn't recover over time, I recommend bringing members with the “Call for Reinforcements” skill or adding a Valkyrie to the squad.
m400398.出撃前の留意事項ですが、今回のミッションは\n敵の討伐を目指す『大討伐ミッション: A quick note before we deploy: this mission is a “Grand Annihilation Mission,” aiming to defeat the enemies.
m400398.情報ありがとうございます。\nでは、戦いはあると考えて、\n騒動の現場である式場: Thanks for the intel. Then, assuming a fight's likely, let's head to the venue where the commotion's happening.
m400398.拠点のライフが0になった場合でも、\nそれまでの討伐数が記録として残りますので、: Even if our base's life drops to zero, the number of enemies you've slain will still be recorded, so don't fear falling—keep pressing the attack.
m400398.王子とランウェイを歩き、\nライスシャワーを受ける目玉イベントを、\n婚姻の儀式: He might be misinterpreting the marquee event—walking the runway with the Prince and getting a rice-shower—as a marriage ceremony.

m400552.――兵たちの士気、いつになく高いね。\nうん、これなら、悲観する必要はなさそう。: ——The troops' morale is higher than ever. Yeah, with this we don't need to be pessimistic.
m400552.――王都防衛戦、戦闘前の記録。\n文責、神殿書記官レーヴ……っと。: ——Record of the Royal Capital Defense, pre-battle log. Author, Temple Scribe Reve… uh.
m400552.…………処刑されても文句の言えない立場だが、\n戦場に出ることを許してくれたこと: ………I'm in a position where I can't complain even if I'm executed, so I'm grateful you let me step onto the battlefield.
m400552.……勝てますよね、きっと。: …We'll win, right? I'm sure we will.
m400552.『援軍要請』を持つ者や、\nワルキューレを出撃メンバーに加えることをお勧めします: I recommend anyone with a “Request Reinforcements” ability, or adding Valkyries to your sortie team.
m400552.あと、山賊に盗賊に海賊は聞いておいてほしいんだが……。\n敵を倒しても、EXPや: One more thing—tell the bandits, thieves, and pirates… don't expect to get EXP or gold just for killing them. You probably already know that, though.
m400552.いや、王都で魔力砲をぶっ放すわけにはいかないだろ。: No, we can't just fire the magic cannon over the capital.
m400552.うっ……さっきから何度も深呼吸してるんですけどね……。\n神聖騎士団の大部隊が、: Ugh… I've been taking deep breaths over and over… thinking that a huge force of Holy Knights is still targeting the capital…
m400552.おそらく、神聖騎士団はもはや余力を考えず、\n物質界連合軍の主要拠点すべてに進軍: Likely the Holy Knights will stop holding back, marching on every major Material-Realm Alliance base. Of those, this capital will face the fiercest onslaught.
m400552.こちらの被害を抑えるのも重要ではあるが、\nとにかく敵の数を減らすことに集中して: Cutting our own losses matters, but focus on thinning their numbers above all else.
m400552.それから、王都全域での戦闘になりますから、\n補給も難しくなります。\n出撃コス: Also, since the whole capital will be a battlefield, supplies will be hard to come by. You can't count on recovery from the passage of time on deployment cost.
m400552.はい……そう、ですよね。\n弱気になってちゃいけませんよね！: Yes… that's right. I can't afford to be defeatist!
m400552.よし、じめじめするのはここまでだ！\nそろそろ魔力ジャミングが消失する。\n総員: All right, enough of the gloom! The magic-jamming is fading. Everyone, make sure you come back alive!
m400552.ん……戦闘記録か、ありがたい。\nしかし緊張しすぎだぞ、書記官殿。: Hmm… a battle record, thanks. But don't get too nervous, Scribe.
m400552.ドーンブリンガーの魔力砲という\n切り札を自ら封印することになるがな……。: We'll end up sealing our own trump card, the Dawn Bringer's magic cannon…
m400552.フローガさんの報告では、\n神聖騎士団側の転移魔法の出力が急上昇中とのこと。\n: According to Floega's report, the Holy Knights' teleport spell output is spiking. …Looks like the battle will start any moment.
m400552.ライフが０になっても気にする必要はない。\n諦めず、何度でも出撃して敵を倒すんだ: Even if your HP hits zero, don't worry about it. Keep sending out squads and defeat them over and over. I'll keep track of how many you've slain as your battle record.
m400552.今この物質界で一番安全な場所が、\nあらゆる時代の叡智が集ったあの船だ。: Right now, the safest place in this material world is that ship that gathers the wisdom of all ages.
m400552.何の憂いもなく、\nあとは神聖騎士団を叩き潰すだけだ。: With no worries left, all that remains is to crush the Holy Knights.
m400552.保証はしかねる、が……。\nジメネスが死ぬまでは、生き延びるよう努力しよう。: I can't guarantee that… but as long as Jimenes lives, I'll do my best to survive.
m400552.前回の襲撃でも、天界兵は\n外装の破壊はできても、内部への侵入はできなかった。\: Even in the last raid, the Celestial troops could damage the hull but couldn't get inside. That ship, which can deflect teleport magic, will protect the people.
m400552.大丈夫です、レーヴさん。\n魔物復活の時とは違います。\n今のこの国は、とても強: It'll be fine, Reve. This isn't like the monster-revival incident. This country has become much stronger, don't you think?
m400552.王国軍は物質界連合と協力し、\n王都全域に防衛部隊を配置。\nさらに周辺都市とも: The kingdom's forces are cooperating with the Material Realm Alliance, deploying defense units throughout the capital, and maintaining constant communications with the surrounding cities.
m400552.王都を勝手に死に場所にしないでね、\n元騎士団長殿？: Please don't turn the capital into a death trap, former Grand Knight-Commander?
m400552.現在、パルセさんと\n飛空戦艦ドーンブリンガーの仕掛けた\n魔力ジャミングにより: Right now, thanks to Mr. Parsee and the airborne warship Dawn Bringer's magical jamming, we're disrupting the enemy's teleport spells.
m400552.私たちも配置に就きましょう。\n魔力ジャミングが弱まれば、\n敵は転移魔法で、あ: We'll take our positions too. If the magical jamming weakens, the enemy will appear everywhere with their teleport spells.
m400552.総数不明の大部隊を相手にする上で、\n重要なのは、とにかく『敵を倒し続けること』: When facing an unknown-size massive force, the key is simple—just keep taking the enemy down.
m400552.避難を希望する王都住民の乗艦も完了したって報告があったよ。\nそれにしても、ドー: We've got a report that the evacuation ships for the capital's civilians are ready. Still, loading civilians onto the Dawn Bringer and sending them skyward—that was a clever idea.

m400565.――やばいですよ王子様！\n私たち、とんでもないものを見つけちゃったかもです！！:
This is bad, Your Highness!
We might've stumbled onto something terrible!!
m400565.あ、あの……私たち、マインさんに誘われて、\n近場の洞窟を探検してたんです。: Um… we were invited by Mine to explore a nearby cave.
m400565.あと、今回は敵を倒しても、\nEXPやゴールド、ドロップ品は入手できないと思って: Also, this time you won't get any EXP, gold, or drops even if you defeat enemies.
m400565.あれは絶対未確認生物だって！\n最近流行りの雑誌で似たようなの見たもん！:
That has to be an unidentified creature!
I saw something similar in a trendy magazine recently!
m400565.ええと、実際危険な魔物たちが洞窟にはいるわけですし……。\nよろしければその……: Well, there are indeed dangerous monsters in the cave… If you're willing, we'd like to ask you to… deal with them.
m400565.せやせや、そんなオカルトじみたもん、\nいるならうちが会いたいくらいやわ。: Exactly, that occult nonsense—if it exists, we'd love to meet it.
m400565.せやなぁ、魔物はぎょうさんおるみたいやし、\n『大討伐ミッション』で片付けるんが: Yeah, there seem to be tons of monsters, so a “Grand Extermination Mission” should do the trick.
m400565.そしたらですね、見たことない魔物が、\n洞窟からめちゃくちゃ飛び出てきたんですよ: Then, out of nowhere, a monster we'd never seen burst out of the cave!
m400565.たぶん洞窟の奥に邪悪な地底人とかがいるんですよ！\nそいつらが未確認生物を集めて: Probably there's some evil subterranean folk deep in the cave! They're gathering these unidentified creatures to plan an invasion of the surface!
m400565.ちげーよ！ もっとやばいものだって！\n未確認生物だよ、未確認生物！！:
No, it's way worse!
It's an unidentified creature, an unidentified creature!!
m400565.なんや、とんでもないものって。\n人間関係を滅茶苦茶にするメイド吸血鬼でも見つけ:
What do you mean, “terrible”?
Did you find a maid vampire that messes up relationships or something?
m400565.ほな、部隊を編成して洞窟に向かおうか。\n『大討伐ミッション』の始まりや！: Well then, let's organize our squad and head to the cave. The “Grand Extermination Mission” begins!
m400565.まぁ、被害が起きてるのは確かだし、\n洞窟に向かった方がいいんじゃないかしら？: Well, the damage is real, so we should probably head to the cave, don't you think?
m400565.変な本の影響を受けおって……。\n未確認生物なんておるわけないじゃろ。: He's been influenced by some weird book… There's no such thing as unidentified creatures.
m400565.彼女たちが見たものがなんだったかはともかく。\n調べてみたところ、洞窟近辺の村で: Whatever they saw, it seems the nearby village has been suffering damage from an unknown monster.
m400565.洞窟の中じゃ補給は上手くいかない。\n出撃コストは回復しないから、『援軍要請』持:
Supplies won't work well inside the cave.
Since deployment costs don't recover, you'll need to bring a “Reinforcement Request” or field a Valkyrie squad.
m400565.王子、こいつは物質界の危機だって！\nほっといたら地上が侵略されちまうよ！:
Prince, this is a crisis for the material world!
If we ignore it, the surface will be overrun!
m400565.目標は、洞窟内の魔物の数を可能な限り減らすことです。\n一体でも多くの敵を撃破す:
Your objective is to reduce the number of monsters in the cave as much as possible.
Focus on defeating as many enemies as you can.
m400565.相手は未確認生物だ。\nそいつらがなんか持ってるとは思えないからな。: The foes are unidentified creatures. I don't expect them to be carrying anything.
m400565.魔物の数は非常に多いと予想されます！\nライフが０となっても、それまでに倒した敵:
We expect the monster count to be huge!
Even if your life reaches zero, the number of enemies you've slain will still be counted, so prioritize annihilating them!
m400565.（ドワーフと吸血鬼が言えたことかしら……）: (I wonder if a dwarf and a vampire can even say that…)

m400590.――おっと、ちょうど話が終わったところか？\n一応、戦争にはお題目が必要だからな:
――Oh, just in time to finish our discussion?
Well, a war needs a proper cause, after all.
Let me state our demands……
m400590.――だめですよ。\nこれは戦争です。経験値やゴールド、\nドロップアイテムも得る:
――No, that won't do.
This is a war. We can't gain any experience points, gold,
or drop items.
m400590.――はぁ、はぁ……ふぇぇ……。\nま、間に合ったようですね……。:
――Ha, ha…… phew…….
I guess I made it in time…….
m400590.――来てくれたか、王子よ！\n見よ、城壁の外は見渡す限り竜、竜、竜だ！:
――You've come, Prince!
Look, beyond the city walls, as far as the eye can see, there are dragons, dragons, and more dragons!
m400590.――竜都そのものをここへ移動させ、\nドラゴンの国すべての戦力をもって\n天眼ノ: —To move the Dragon Capital itself here and crush the Sky-Eye Nation with the full military might of the Dragon Country. Correct, isn't it?
m400590.…………。\nおい、いいのかアングハラド。\n大事な愛娘だろ？ あれは敵側に付く:
…………

Hey, is that alright, Angarad?

She's your precious daughter, you know. She's siding with the enemy.
m400590.…………すまぬ、王子。\nわらわでは、太守を止められなんだ。:
…………Forgive me, Prince.

I failed to stop the Grand Lord.
m400590.……あれ？ 何だか空が暗くなってきたような？: ……Huh? It seems the sky is getting dark?
m400590.……お前は、昔から優しい子だったな。\n現実を見せようと先鋒を任せたが仇になった:
……You were always such a gentle soul.

I made you the vanguard to show you the truth,

but it only turned against me.
m400590.……ちなみに、ドラゴンっていえば\n金銀財宝って相場が決まってるが――:
……By the way, when it comes to dragons,
it's always assumed they hoard gold, silver, and treasures, but――
m400590.……ひとつ。手薄になった地域へ侵攻し、\n領土を切り取らんと考える。\nこれは互: ……One. They intend to invade the areas left thinly defended and carve out territory. That would be the case if both sides held territory on the ground.
m400590.……交渉は、無駄でしょうね。: ……Negotiations are a waste of time, aren't they?
m400590.……姫様。\nそろそろ、大人になってください。:
……Princess.

It is time you grew up.
m400590.……策略だろうと泥舟だろうと、\n乗らねばならぬ時もあるということです、姫様。:
……Whether it's a scheme or a sinking ship,
there are times when one must board it, Your Highness.
m400590.『援軍要請』を持つ方や、ワルキューレの方、\nそれから私たちのような商人に、ぜひ:
Those who have 『Request Reinforcements』, the Valkyries,
and merchants like us, please feel free to place your orders.
m400590.あえてこれだけの軍勢を送り込み、\nこちらの主力を一箇所に集中させた。\nその真: They deliberately sent such a massive force to concentrate our main army in one place. If there is a true intent behind it, there are only two possibilities.
m400590.あれなるは、創生の戦いにて生み出されし、\n世界を砕き、紡ぎ直すもの。: That thing was born in the War of Creation. It is the one that shatters the world and weaves it anew.
m400590.あれは「しょうがないなぁ、うちの問題児は」\nという表情だったかと……。: They looked like they were thinking, “I suppose I can't help it, my troublesome one.”
m400590.えぇ、わかっていますよ姫様。\n――だが、竜都の民は、そうは考えない。:
Yes, I understand that, Your Highness.
――But the people of the Dragon Capital do not see it that way.
m400590.えっと……昔の仲間――と言っても、\n天眼ノ国の方には伝わらないですよね……。: Um…… my old comrades――though, I suppose that wouldn't mean much to people from the Land of the Heavenly Eye……
m400590.くっ……もう、いい。\n進む道は、わらわが自分で決める。:
Grr…… Fine.

I will choose my own path.
m400590.この戦い、作戦は大討伐の形式を取るべきかな。\n敵は間違いなく多勢。\n一体でも:
For this battle, we should adopt the format of a Grand Subjugation.
The enemy will certainly be numerous.
It will be crucial to defeat as many of them as possible.
m400590.これでよい。\nどちらが勝とうとも、\nこれで竜の血が絶えることはない。:
It is as it should be.

No matter who wins,

the dragon bloodline will not be extinguished.
m400590.さぁ、やろうか。\n共に民の命運を背負った者同士、\n退くことなど最初からありえ:
Now then, let's begin.
We are both bearing the fate of our people,
so there was never any chance of us backing down.
m400590.しかし、地に降り、\n他の者らとともに共存していく未来はないのか！？:
But is there no future where we descend to the ground

and live in harmony with the others?!
m400590.そういうことかよ。\nじゃあ、まぁ、滅びゆく種族の将として、\n少しばかり原初の:
I see.

Well then, as a general of a dying race,

I suppose I'll show you a taste of that primordial terror.
m400590.そのときは、素直に負けを認めてやるよ。: If you succeed, I will honestly admit defeat.
m400590.ただ、この城塞はかなり古いものに見えます。\n補給物資も足りていない以上、\n出:
However, this fortress appears to be quite old.
Given that our supplies are insufficient,
we cannot expect our deployment cost to recover over time.
m400590.だが、わらわは確かに、\n異世界の者たちと語り合うた！\nあの者らなら、きっとわ:
But I have spoken with those from another world!

I am certain that with them, we could understand each other—
m400590.だが、此度の勝利はこちらに――いや、\nそういうことか……。: But this victory belongs to us— no, wait. I see now.
m400590.では、あとは全力で戦うのみだな。\n長らく甘やかされてきた他の貴族連中も、\nよ:
Then, all that remains is to fight with all our might.
The other nobles, who have been spoiled for so long,
will finally be forced to face reality.
m400590.なんだ、あの巨大な……ドラゴン、なのか……？: What is that giant…… is that a dragon……?
m400590.はい。その、実はスカベンジャーの方々が\n手を貸してくださって……。:
Yes. Actually, the Scavengers have
been lending a hand…….
m400590.まぁまぁ、後で説明しますから！\nともかく彼女は信頼できる人ですから、\n民間人:
Now, now, I'll explain later!
Anyway, she's someone we can trust, so let's leave the civilians' protection to her!
m400590.まずい……やばいよこれ！\nあれ！ 空みて！ こっちに向かってる！: This is bad…… it's really bad! Look! Look at the sky! It's coming this way!
m400590.むっ……天眼があるではないか。\nそなた、天眼ノ民なのか？: Hmph…… so you bear the Heavenly Eye. Are you a citizen of the Land of the Heavenly Eye?
m400590.むっ、占星術師殿か。\nそんなに急いでどうしたのだ。:
Mm, the Astrologer.
Why were you in such a hurry?
m400590.もとより、全員死ぬまで終わらない戦争だ。\n種の存続がかかってるからな。: It was always a war that wouldn't end until everyone was dead. The survival of our species is at stake.
m400590.やれやれ……無理だとわかっていて、\n綺麗事を仰るものだ。\nそういう姫様だから:
Tsk, tsk…… you speak such pretty words,
knowing full well it's impossible.
It's precisely because of a princess like you that deserters have appeared among the soldiers.
m400590.ゆえに、これは避けられぬ戦いだと？: So this is an unavoidable battle, then?
m400590.よし、避けられない戦いなら、\nこちらも万全の備えで迎え撃つしかないだろう。:
Very well. If battle is unavoidable,
we have no choice but to meet it with full preparations.
m400590.わらわはそのような考えで\nこちらに味方したわけではない！:
I did not join this side
because of such ideas!
m400590.わらわも戻らぬ。\n太守には、トラハイアよ、\nそなたの口からも戦争を止めるよう:
I shall not return it either.
Governor Trahia, please tell them to stop this war,
in your own words.
m400590.ドラゴンの国との直接対決、\n歴史上なかったことではないですが……。\nそれでも:
A direct confrontation with the dragon nation……
It hasn't happened in history before, but…….
Still, this is the first time I'm standing here for it.
m400590.ニハラよ、民の避難は進んでいるか？: Nihara, is the evacuation of the people going well?
m400590.事情はわかりました。\n国が墜落しかけているとなれば、\n戦いを避けることができ:
I understand the situation.

If the nation is on the verge of falling,

I can see why avoiding battle is impossible.
m400590.他国の力ある結晶を奪ったとて、\n竜都が再び力を取り戻すとは限らぬだろう！\nど:
Even if we seize a powerful crystal from another nation,
it doesn't mean the Dragon Capital will regain its strength!
That man is surely just following Morion's orders!
m400590.個として優れた種であるほど、\n凡百の力が束ねられた\n集団の恐ろしさを知るもの:
The more superior a species is as an individual,
the more it understands the terror of a collective
wherein the strength of the many is combined.
m400590.全軍、咆哮をあげよ！\n空の覇者が誰であるか、見せてやれ！:
All units, let out your roar!
Show them who the true sovereign of the sky is!
m400590.初めまして、皆さま。\n私はケルドラ、古き時代より生きるただの――: Greetings, everyone. I am Kerudra, a mere being who has lived since the age of antiquity――
m400590.古い知り合いが突然訪ねてきて、\n天眼ノ国の民を守る戦いに助力したい、と……。: An old acquaintance of mine came by out of the blue and said he wanted to help defend the people of the Land of the Heavenly Eye……
m400590.天眼核を渡せ。\nうちの姫様も返してくれると助かるが、\nこればかりは、本人が決:
Hand over the Heavenly Eye Core.
It would help if your Highness returned ours, too,
but that is a decision only she can make.
m400590.天竜核……。\nこの大地を空に浮かべるためには、\nもはやその力が枯れかけている:
The Dragon Core……

The power that keeps this land aloft

is nearly spent. I am aware of that.
m400590.好きにせよ。\n竜の運命は、自ら選ぶものだ。:
Do as you please.

A dragon's fate is one it chooses for itself.
m400590.姫様が惚れ込むのも分かる。\n絆だの仲間だの、数を頼る力はあまりにも暴力的だ。:
I can understand why Your Highness is so smitten.
Bonds, comrades, relying on numbers…… it's all so violently powerful.
m400590.悪いが、滅ぶことを恐れる者に、\n憎しみではなく恐怖によって戦いを選ぶ者に、\n: I'm sorry, but your hand cannot reach those who fight out of fear of extinction, not hatred.
m400590.我らが故郷たるこの空飛ぶ大地に、\nもはや幾許も時間は残されておらぬ。:
There is little time left

for this flying land, our homeland.
m400590.我らは強く、ゆえにあまりに弱い。\n長きにわたる寿命と、つがいなくとも子をなし得:
We are strong, and therefore all the more fragile.

Because of our long lives and the ability to bear young

even without a mate—
m400590.我らは死と継承による変化を\nこれまでろくに得ることができなかったのだ。:
We have never truly been able to gain change

through death and succession.
m400590.数を減らすことが大切ということですね。\nライフが０となっても、\nそれまでに倒:
So reducing their numbers is the priority, I see.
Even if my life reaches zero,
I will record the results of the enemies defeated up to that point.
m400590.断ります。天眼核の譲渡など、\nそれは即ち、民を守る力を譲るに等しい。:
We refuse. Surrendering the Heavenly Eye Core
is the same as surrendering the power to protect our people.
m400590.竜など、弱点だらけだ。\nその鱗が、吐息が、どれだけ強かろうとも……。:
Dragons are riddled with weaknesses.

No matter how strong our scales or breath may be……
m400590.竜の国が戦火振りまく戦闘国家となった背景に、\n他種族への恐怖心があったなんて…:
So the dragon nation turned into a war-mongering state out of fear of the other races……
Ah, but I suppose the Heavenly Eye nation is no different.
m400590.竜の民、その全てを救えるっていうのなら、\nやってみればいいさ。: If you say you can save all the Dragon people, then go ahead and try.
m400590.竜は、種として強くなりすぎた。\n誰もが恐れる存在が弱みを見せれば、\nもはやそ:
As a species, dragons have become too strong.

If an existence that everyone fears shows a weakness,

then war is all that remains.
m400590.竜都、ドラゴンの国、天飛ぶ大地。\n呼び名は数多くありますが……。: The Dragon Capital, the Dragon Country, the land that flies in the sky. It has many names……
m400590.竜都が、空中都市リヴァイアサンが\nその動力を失い、地に墜ちたなら、\n人類は間: If the Dragon Capital, the aerial city of Leviathan, were to lose its power and crash to the ground, humanity would surely come hunting us.
m400590.竜都の戦士たちよ、\n故郷のため、その命を捧げよ。:
Warriors of the Dragon Capital,
sacrifice your lives for your homeland!
m400590.聞いてるぜ、異世界の王子。\n敵にすら手を差し伸べるお人好しってな。: I'm listening, Prince of another world. You, who would even offer a hand to the enemy.
m400590.自らの住処たる地上に、強大な竜が降りてきたなら、\n人の子らは間違いなく、我らを:
If a mighty dragon were to descend

upon the lands where humans dwell,

they would undoubtedly hunt us to extinction.
m400590.親友が困ってるって言ったら、\nみんな大喜びで協力してくれたよ！:
When I said my best friend was in trouble,
everyone was happy to help!
m400590.遅かれ早かれ、\n我ら竜は必ず地を這う者たちと\n殺し合う運命にある。それは理解:
In time, sooner or later,

we dragons are fated to fight to the death

with those who crawl upon the earth. I understand that.
m400590.（ソラスさんの古い知り合いというと、つまり……）: (If Solais's old acquaintance is here, then that means……)
m400590.（英傑、ということですよね？）: (It's one of the Heroes, isn't it?)

m500161.……そうですね。\n大きな犠牲もなく強力な魔神を撃退できた。\nこれ以上を望むの: …That's right. We drove off a mighty demon without any great sacrifice. Wanting more than that would be greedy.
m500161.あの深い霧の中では、\n訓練を積んでいない人達の射撃は\n対処が難しいのではない: In that dense fog, anyone without proper training will find it hard to aim properly...
m500161.このままでは森が全て魔界化してしまうのも\n時間の問題です……そうなる前に、\n: If we don't act, the whole forest will soon become a demonic realm—it's only a matter of time. Let's defeat Barbatos before that happens!
m500161.すみません、声を荒げて入ってしまって。\nで、でも、どうしても王子さまに\n急ぎ: I'm sorry for barging in like this. But there's something urgent I must tell you right away!
m500161.その毒は受ける痛みが倍増する猛毒だと言われています。\n戦う際には後方支援の兵が: That poison is said to double the pain it inflicts. When we fight, we need defenders who can protect our rear and those with strong defenses.
m500161.それでは王子、王国へ帰還致しましょう。\n魔神バルバトスの撃退、お疲れ様でした！: Then, Prince, let's return to the kingdom. Good work on repelling Barbatos!
m500161.それとバルバトスの現れた森には怪しげな霧が立ち込め、\n霧に包まれた木々はさなが: Also, the forest where Barbatos appeared is shrouded in a strange mist, and the trees wrapped in it are turning into something that looks like demonic wood.
m500161.そんな……！\n森をこんな姿にした魔神を、\nみすみす見逃すしかないなんて……。: No... To let that demon, which has twisted this forest, slip away right before our eyes...
m500161.もし霧中の戦いになる際は、\n私達レンジャーにお任せください。\n絶対に、王子さ: If we have to fight within the mist, leave it to us Rangers. We'll definitely prove useful to you, Prince!
m500161.仮初の姿こそ人のようですが、魔神の本性を現した際は\n一度に複数の対象を射抜く、: Though it may look human at first, when its true demonic form emerges it can wield a massive bow that pierces multiple targets at once.
m500161.伝承の通りなら、バルバトスが用いる弓矢には\n強力な毒が塗られている筈です……。: According to the lore, the arrows Barbatos uses are coated with a potent poison...
m500161.待ってください、スプラさん！\n瘴霧が引いたとはいえ、\nこの見通しの悪い森での: Wait, Supura! Even though the mist has lifted, pursuing it in this low-visibility forest is still too risky!

m920054.分からん。確証はない。\nだが、これ程までに強いというのは、\n他に考えられん。: I don't know. No proof. But someone this strong… there's no other explanation.
m920054.到着しました。\nここが我々の住む自由都市です。:
We've arrived.
This is the Free City where we live.
m920054.国は違えど、お互いに共通の敵がいる間柄だ。\n今後何かあればいつでも手を貸す。:
Though our nations differ, we share a common enemy.
If anything comes up, I'll lend a hand anytime.
m920054.報告！ 前方から魔物の姿を確認！\nこちらに向かってきています！:
Report! Monsters spotted ahead!
They're heading this way!
m920054.報告！ 戦況は劣勢です。\n徐々に後退させられています！:
Report! We're losing ground.
We're being forced to retreat gradually!
m920054.報告！ 武器を持った人影を確認！\nこちらに迫ってきています！\nあれは……自由: Report! We've spotted a shadow with weapons! They're moving toward us! Wait… that's… from the Free City…?!
m920054.対象を食べる事で、記憶さえ奪う事ができるんだ。: By eating its target, it can even steal its memories.
m920054.帝国の方！ ご無事でよかったです。\nこの辺りのドッペルゲンガーは倒す事が出来ま:
Imperial forces! I'm glad you're safe.
We've managed to defeat the Doppelgangers around here.
m920054.帝国軍が向かってきております！\n王子、ここは撃退するしかないようです。: Imperial troops are on the way! Prince, we have no choice but to drive them back.
m920054.待ってください！ 一体なぜ！？\nどうか武器をおさめてください。: Please, wait! Why are you doing this?! Lay down your weapons, I beg you.
m920054.心配するな。\n全員の撤退を確認したら、\n私も後からすぐに追いつく。さっさとい:
Don't worry.
Once everyone's withdrawal is confirmed,
I'll catch up right after. Move quickly.
m920054.忌まわしい魔物め！\n全て倒してやる！:
Accursed monsters!
I'll wipe you all out!
m920054.我々の事を魔物などと……。\n帝国軍の兵士たちは、正気ではないようです。:
To call us monsters…
The Empire soldiers have clearly lost their minds.
m920054.我々はどの国にも属さず\n自分たちの力で街を守ってきました。\nそれが自由都市の:
We belong to no nation and have protected our town with our own strength.
That was the pride of the Free City, but…
m920054.承知しました。\n全部隊に、一度軍を街から引くよう伝えます。: Understood. I'll order every unit to withdraw from the city.
m920054.最後まで自由都市を守り抜こうとするあなた方の\nこれまでのご苦労は察するに余りあ: We can only imagine the hardships you've endured, fighting to protect the Free City to the very end.
m920054.残念だが、その願いを聞き入れる事は出来ん。\nさぁ、皆、英雄の末裔を滅ぼすのだ！: Sorry, but we can't grant that request. Come on, everyone—let's wipe out the heroes' descendants!
m920054.気を落とされないでください。\n街を解放するため、私たちも協力させていただきます: Don't lose hope. We'll do everything we can to free the city!
m920054.王子、ドッペルゲンガーの生き残りが\nまだいるようです！\n戦闘の準備を。:
Prince, there are still surviving Doppelgangers!
Prepare for battle.
m920054.王子、白の帝国がこちらに向かってきます！\n話を聞くつもりは全くないようです。: Prince, the White Empire is marching toward us! They have no intention of listening.
m920054.王子。\nあの偽王子ですが、\n戦いぶりを見ていて気が付いた事があります。:
Prince.
About that fake prince—
I've noticed something while watching his fighting.
m920054.王子！ あそこに白の帝国の軍が……！: Prince! The White Empire's army is over there…!
m920054.白の帝国のみなさん、\nこれ以上の戦いは無意味です！\n私たちが戦う理由はありま: People of the White Empire, further fighting is pointless! We have no reason to fight!
m920054.白の帝国軍……！\nという事は、我々の街はもう既に……。: White Empire troops…! That means our city is already…
m920054.相次ぐ魔物の襲撃に住民は傷つき、\nその混乱に乗じて帝国にまで攻めてこられては…: Repeated monster raids have wounded the residents, and in the chaos the Empire has even begun to invade…
m920054.礼には及ばん。\n今回は協力したが、次会うときは敵かもしれんからな。:
No need for thanks.
We cooperated this time, but the next time we meet they might be enemies.
m920054.私たちは王子が戦場にいらっしゃるだけで士気が\n上がりますが、どうやら偽王子は魔: Just having you on the battlefield lifts our morale, but it seems the fake prince can't boost the monsters' morale at all.
m920054.自由都市の兵士さん。\n良かったです。ご無事だったのですね。: Free City Soldier, I'm glad you're safe.
m920054.自由都市の兵士さんは、\n隠れていてください。ここは私たちが何とかします。: Free City soldiers, please hide. We'll handle this.
m920054.良かった。\nこれで、この自由都市に巣食っていた\nドッペルゲンガーは全て滅ぼす:
Good.
Now it seems we've exterminated every Doppelganger that was nesting in this free city.
m920054.良かった。\nどうやら引いてくれたようです。: That's a relief. It looks like they've withdrawn.
m920054.見つけたぞ！\nそう簡単に逃げられると思っているのか？:
Found you!
Did you really think you could get away that easily?
m920054.馬鹿め、帝国の本隊はそこまで来ている。\nあの程度でわれらが敗北するわけなかろう: Foolish— the Imperial main force is already that far ahead. We won't be defeated by something this trivial.
m920054.魔物の群れをこともなく撃退するとは……！\nさすがは伝説の英雄の末裔にあらせられ: To defeat that horde of monsters without breaking a sweat…! You truly are the descendant of a legendary hero!

m920063.――お褒めに与り恐悦至極！\n久しいな、ラキュアよ。まだ人間との共存など\nとい: ――Your compliments are most humbling! Long time no see, Racua. Still dreaming of that lukewarm ideal of coexisting with humans?
m920063.――ほう。\nあの傷で死んでいなかったとは\n大したものだな。: —Hmm. To think you didn't die from that wound… impressive.
m920063.――グッ、ぁァ……そんな、バカ、な……。\n人間ごときが、我を圧倒するというのか: —Gah, ah… such… foolishness… How can a mere human overwhelm me…?
m920063.――ッ！\nあれは、ラキュア！\n氏族の者達も連れているようですね。:
——! 
That's Racua!
It seems she's brought members of her clan with her.
m920063.――見つけましたよ、ラキュア。\nやはり復活を果たしたようですね……。\n今度こ:
—— I've found you, Racua.
As expected, you've achieved resurrection... 
This time, I'll finish you off with my own hand!
m920063.…………行ってしまったな。\n公爵め、人心掌握の手管は完璧のようだ。\nしかし、: ………He's gone. The duke's grip on people's hearts seems flawless. Still, they'll eventually turn on him…
m920063.……御意。\n然らば、祈られよ、ルマリア殿。: …As you wish. Then pray, Lady Rumaria.
m920063.……肝心なところでヤツを見失うなんて。\n確かこっちに逃げたはずですが……。: ???: …Losing sight of the target at the crucial moment. I'm sure it ran this way…
m920063.……覚悟せよ、ヴァンパイア。\n貴様を滅ぼした先で、\n私は、私自身を取り戻して: Prepare yourself, vampire. After I destroy you, I'll reclaim myself.
m920063.あ……行ってしまわれましたね。\n一体何だったのでしょうか。:
Ah… They've gone.
What on earth was that?
m920063.あの噴水のヴァンパイアは……！\nアイツは、私の家族を殺したヴァンパイア……。\: That vampire by the fountain…! He's the one who killed my family… No doubt about it—how could I ever forget that face…
m920063.あの無数の骨は何……？\nうそ……でしょう？\nまさかアレ……ぜんぶ人間の……？: What are all those countless bones…? No way… Could it be… they're all… humans…?
m920063.いずれ、またヴァンパイア達と戦う日が来るの\nでしょうか……いえ、今はルマリアさ: Perhaps one day we'll have to fight vampires again… No, for now let's rejoice that we rescued Rumaria and the others. Prince, thank you for everything.
m920063.がっはっはっはっ！\nワシが来たからにはもう心配はいらんですぞ。\nさあ、共にラ:
Gahahaha! 
Now that I'm here, you have nothing to worry about.
Come, let's corner Racua together!
m920063.くっ……。\n王子、今は、この死地を脱する事に\n専念しましょう。: Damn… Prince, for now let's focus on getting out of this death-trap.
m920063.くッ……今は退くしかないようです。: Damn… It looks like we have no choice but to retreat for now.
m920063.ぐす……父様……母様……ごめんなさい……。\n守り切れなかった私を……許して……: …Father… Mother… I'm sorry… Forgive me for not being able to protect you… Please forgive my heart that's been driven by rage…
m920063.ここは公爵が「家畜部屋」と称している\n場所じゃ……。: This is the place the Duke calls a “livestock pen”…
m920063.このままでは、\nルマリアさんは、公爵の手に……。: If we do nothing, Rumaria will fall into the Duke's hands…
m920063.このルマリアが\nあなたたちを神の名の下に断罪します！\n覚悟しなさい！: ???: I, Lumaria, will condemn you in the name of God! Prepare yourself!
m920063.この灰ですか？ \n今、皆で集めてるところです。\nところで貴方は――: This ash? We're all gathering it right now. By the way, who are you—
m920063.この美しい森の草木を、\nこのような灰で汚すなんて許せない……。\n私、ここを掃: To sully the beautiful forest's plants with this ash… I won't stand for it. I'll clean this place up.
m920063.これで……終わった……？\nみんなの仇を取れたの……でしょうか……？: Is it… over now? Have I… avenged everyone…?
m920063.これも何かの縁だ。礼ついでに一つ忠告して\nおこう。強大な力を有するヴァンパイア: This must be fate. While I'm at it, let me give you a warning. Vampires with great power intend to dominate all humanity.
m920063.せっかく逃げ果せたというのにとんだ愚か者だ。\nまた殺されに来るとは、理解に苦し: You escaped, yet you're such a fool. Coming back to be killed again—beyond comprehension.
m920063.そういうことなら私達も同行しましょう。\n先程の女性も心配ですし、彼女ならば支配:
If that's the case, we'll go with you.
We're also worried about that woman earlier, and she should know where the domination leader is.
m920063.そういうわけだ。悪いが失礼するよ。\n生きていたら、また会おう。\n我が麗しき愚: That's that. Forgive my departure. If you're still alive, we'll meet again. My beautiful, foolish comrade Racua…
m920063.そして、ヴァンパイアにはいくつかの\n氏族が存在しています。もし彼女の言う事が\: And there are several vampire clans. If what she says is true, this could become a serious problem…
m920063.そして、予は、共存派のリーダーだった。: And I was the leader of the coexistence faction.
m920063.それだけの蘇生力をもつということは、ヴァン\nパイアの中でも相当な上位種というこ: A resurrection ability like that means it's a high-rank vampire indeed.
m920063.それに、普通の吸血鬼なら殺して灰にすれば、\nそのまま滅びるはずですが、\nあの:
Moreover, an ordinary vampire would turn to ash when killed,
but that one has resurrected.
m920063.そんな……。\n私達はヴァンパイアを\n復活させてしまったというのですか……。:
That's impossible…
Are you saying we've resurrected a vampire…?
m920063.ついに公爵が氏族のヴァンパイア達を\n解き放ったというわけか……。: So the Duke finally released his clan's vampires…
m920063.どちらにしても、公爵は滅ぼさねばならぬ。\nニコラウスとやら、そこに案内してもら: Either way, we must destroy the Duke. Let's have Nicholaus lead the way.
m920063.なるほど……。\n灰を集めてヤツを復活させるつもりですね。\n私の目はごまかせま: ???: I see… You're gathering the ash to revive it, aren't you? You can't fool my eyes!
m920063.なるほど。\n噛まなければヴァンパイア化もしないという訳ね。\n永遠に血を吸える: I see. So unless you're bitten you don't turn into a vampire. That means you can feed forever.
m920063.なんという悪逆非道……。許せません。\n一刻も早くルマリアさんを救いましょう！\: How monstrous… I can't forgive this. Let's rescue Rumaria at once! Prince, prepare for battle!
m920063.はぁ……。\n灰をこんなにまき散らしたのは一体誰なのかしら。\n信じられません。: Haa… Who on earth scattered all this ash? I can't believe it.
m920063.はい！ ですが、気をつけてください。\n公爵様の言によれば、あのヴァンパイアは\:
Yes! But be careful.
According to the Duke, that vampire possesses considerable power.
m920063.ま、待って下さい！\n私達は貴方達の敵ではありません。\n人間です！ どうか、武:
W-wait! 
We aren't your enemies.
We're humans! Please, lay down your weapons!
m920063.ようやく、撤退してくれました。\nしかし、話を聞いてもらえそうにないですね……。:
Finally, they've retreated.
But it doesn't look like they'll listen to us...
m920063.ニコラウスさん！？\nその傷はいったい……！？\n血だらけではないですか！: Nicholaus! What… what's that wound? Aren't you covered in blood?!
m920063.ニコラウス様……。私はようやく、\n真実の道に、この足をつけることができたような: Lord Nicholaus… I finally feel like I've set foot on the true path… Prince, thank you so much…
m920063.ニコラウス様……うぅ……そんな……、\n戻ってきて……くださるなんて……。: Lord Nicholaus… sob… I never imagined… you'd return… for me…
m920063.ニコラウス様！？\n救援に来てくださったのですね！\nなんと心強い加勢でしょう。:
Lord Nicholaus!?
You've come to our aid! 
What a reassuring reinforcement.
m920063.ヤツは人間から血液を絞りとる為に、\n死なない程度に痛めつけ、\n滴る血を集約し: He would wound people just enough not to kill them, drawing blood, then gather the dripping blood to sate his thirst…
m920063.ルマリアさん達は\nこの辺りに退却していったはずです。\nしばらく近辺を捜索して: Rumaria and the others should have fallen back around here. Let's search the area for a while.
m920063.ルマリア殿が……まだヤツらに軟禁されている……\nどうか、彼女を助けて下され……: Lady Rumaria… she's still being held captive by them… Please, rescue her…
m920063.ヴァンパイアの本能に従い生きる強硬派。\n人間を支配し、生態系を調整する支配派。: The hardliners who follow vampire instinct, the dominators who seek to control humans and regulate the ecosystem, and the coexistence faction that wishes to live alongside humans.
m920063.ヴァンパイアの氏族が何を言うのかと思えば\nいうに事欠いて人間であるなどと……。:
So the vampire clan claims they're humans, huh? 
They've got no shortage of words…
m920063.ヴァンパイアは人間がいてこそ存在できる。\n一方的な搾取は互いに不利益しか生まな:
Vampires can only exist because of humans.
One-sided exploitation only harms both sides.
I intend to protect humans for the sake of everyone.
m920063.ヴァンパイアは常に適正な数に保たれなければならない。\n数が多すぎると人間を滅ぼ: Vampires must keep their numbers at a proper level. Too many, and they'll wipe out humanity—and end up sealing their own throats.
m920063.ヴァンパイアハンターがヴァンパイアと手を組\nむなんて……今はそんなこと言ってら:
A vampire hunter teaming up with vampires… I guess we can't argue about that now.
If our goals match, fighting together is the best option.
m920063.主よ、私は罪を犯す者。私は罪の奴隷なり。\n主よ、私は自らを以て復仇する復讐者な: Lord, I am a sinner. I am a slave to sin. Lord, I am a revenger who will take vengeance with my own hands. Lord, from the bottom of my heart, I pray… to kill.
m920063.乱心なさいますな、ルマリア殿。\n隣にはこの不肖ニコラウスもついております故、\: Keep your composure, Lady Rumaria. I, the humble Nicholaus, am right beside you, so if you try to go off alone I'll have to stop you—by force if necessary.
m920063.予は、支配派のリーダーを探す。\n先ほど追ってきた人間は支配派の差し向けた\n刺:
I'm searching for the leader of the domination faction.
The human we just chased was an assassin sent by them, but I don't want to fight humans.
m920063.予は公爵の後を追う。\nしばしの別れだ。息災でな。: I shall follow the Duke. It's only a brief parting. Stay safe.
m920063.予は許せぬ。支配派のヴァンパイア達は、\n人を餌と断じ、あまつさえ自らの都合の良: I cannot forgive this. The domination vampires deem humans as mere food, and on top of that they create a reality that suits them, bending thoughts and actions to their will.
m920063.事の重大さは伝わったようだな。\nでは、落ち着ける場所に案内してもらおう。:
Seems you understand the gravity.
Then, lead us to a place where we can settle down.
m920063.人間は互いを想い、時として自らの命を賭けて\n他者を助けたいと願う種族なのだ。\: Humans cherish one another, sometimes willing to risk their lives to help others. You, who have no friends, can't understand.
m920063.伝令！ \n周囲に複数体の敵を確認！\n待ち伏せていたようです！: Messenger! Multiple enemies spotted nearby! They were lying in ambush!
m920063.何とかアンデッドを退けることが出来ましたね。\nですが、公爵には逃げられてしまい: We managed to drive the undead back, but the duke escaped…
m920063.何も見えなくて結構！ \n世界とは未知にして、未踏の地平！\n共に歩んでいきまし: Not seeing anything is fine! The world is unknown, an uncharted horizon! Let's walk it together! Hahaha!
m920063.偽りの平和への対価が命では、\nあまりにも不条理すぎます……。: Paying with lives for a false peace is just too absurd...
m920063.全て、貴方達の言う通りじゃった……。\n公爵は……ヤツは、化け物だ。: Everything turned out exactly as you said… The Duke… that creature is a monster.
m920063.公爵め……我らがルマリアを\n追いかけることを見越しての配置か。: Duke… you anticipated us chasing Rumaria and set this up.
m920063.公爵殿が……ヴァンパイア？\nだっはっは、これは参りましたな。\n久しぶりに笑わ: The duke… a vampire? Ha ha, this is unexpected. It's been a while since I've laughed like this.
m920063.其方こそ、随分と人間の真似事が上手くなった\nようだな。舞台役者にでもなるつもり: You, on the other hand, have become quite good at mimicking humans. Planning to become a stage actor or something?
m920063.其方たち……っふ、どうやら我ら共存派のよき\n理解者となってくれる数少ない人間の:
You lot… hmm, you seem to be the rare humans who truly understand the coexistence side.
From now on, I look forward to working with you.
m920063.其方たちが予の灰を集めてくれたのか？\n礼を言おう。予は、ラキュア。\nヴァンパ:
So you gathered my ash for me?
Allow me to thank you. I am Racua.
A vampire.
m920063.再び新たな合理と調和に満ちた、\n素晴らしき新世界を作り上げ、血液採取の\n永久: I'll create a splendid new world filled with rationality and harmony, a perpetual engine of blood extraction. Fu ha ha ha!!
m920063.前を向くのじゃ、ルマリア殿。\nこの光景こそ、これから貴方が生きる\n世界そのも: Look ahead, Lady Rumaria. This very sight is the world you'll be living in from now on…
m920063.口を慎め、吸血種の恥さらしめ。\n美貌と力の最果てであった貴様は何処へいった？: Mind your tongue, you shameless blood-drinker. Where have you gone, the one who once stood at the pinnacle of beauty and power?
m920063.報告！\nアンデッドの攻勢が激しく\n前線が押されています！: Report! The undead's assault is fierce; the front line is being pushed back!
m920063.大丈夫……大丈夫です……今の私には、\n仲間がいますから……ですが、\nあの噴水: I'm fine… I'm fine. I have allies now… but that vampire at the fountain… I'll be the one to finish him.
m920063.家畜どもよ！ 本当に貴様らはこれで\n良いのか？ これまでの生活を思い出せ！\n: Livestock! Is this truly all you want? Remember your former life! The days when everything was harmonious and fulfilled.
m920063.家畜同士の馴れ合いなどに興味はない。\n欲するは血と統制された社会構造よ。\n人: I have no interest in livestock camaraderie. What I desire is blood and a controlled societal order. Humans belong under the guidance of us vampires.
m920063.嵐に巻き込まれたと思うしかないわね。\nさ、気を取り直して、集めた灰を袋に\n詰:
We can only assume they were caught up in the storm.
Now, let's pull ourselves together and pack the ash we gathered—whoa, the ash just started moving!
m920063.彼らの処遇は決している。\n利用価値の無い家畜は食すに限る。\n若い女の血は絶品: Their fate is decided. Worthless livestock are only good for food. Young women's blood is exquisite—truly something to look forward to.
m920063.彼奴らは騙されているのだ。支配派のリーダーは\n人間社会で「公爵」という立場を持:
They're being deceived. The leader of the domination faction holds the title of "Duke" in human society.
Using that position, they manipulate humans.
m920063.必然的に我らヴァンパイアは争い、\n数多く存在していた氏族も今や三つの勢力を\n: Inevitably, we vampires clashed, and the once-numerous clans have been whittled down to three factions. That's what they call the proper count.
m920063.悪い予感がします……。\n王子、彼らのあとを追いましょう！: I have a bad feeling… Prince, let's pursue them!
