are together again.
This must surely be the will of the gods.
m920187.……確かに、酷い有様だ。\n亜神だ神だと言いながら、民を守ることもできていない。:
……Indeed, it's a sorry state of affairs.
Claiming to be a demigod or a god, yet unable to protect your people.
m920187.……言ってくれますね。\n次に王都へ攻めてきたら、\n返り討ちにしてやりますから:
……You certainly know how to say things.
If you come attacking the capital next,
we'll crush you.
m920187.……陛下、見逃してよろしかったのですか？: ……Your Majesty, was it truly wise to let him go?
m920187.……頼んでないわ、そんなこと。\nいつか私が悪神になった時、\n私を滅ぼす手段に:
……I never asked for that.
So that when I became an evil god someday,
you would be the means to destroy me――
m920187.あ、アラエルさま……！？\nぼくだよ！ パリオスだよ！！:
Ah, Arael-sama……!?
It's me! It's Pallios!!
m920187.あ、アンジェリーネ様は……そんなことは言わん！\nあの御方はもっと高貴で、もっと:
A-Angelene-sama, please don't say such things!
She is far too noble, far too cold――
m920187.あぁら、最初から分かっているでしょう？\n何しろここは敵の本拠地だもの！:
Ah, I knew that from the start, didn't I?
After all, this is the enemy's home turf!
m920187.ああ、ああ、そうに違いない……。\nギガエル、送ってくれますか？\nどうしてか、:
Ah, yes, that must be it…….
Gigael, will you see us off?
For some reason, I'm so very tired…….
m920187.あいつは優しいとかそういうのじゃないぞ。\nただひたすら、不器用なんだ。\n理不:
It's not that he's kind or anything.
He's just… clumsy with his feelings.
A fool who can't stand injustice, yet insists on fighting alone.
m920187.あっ、シャディアと話してたから嫉妬した？\n嫉妬したんだゴライア！！:
Oh, were you jealous because I was talking to Shadia?
You were jealous, Goliah!
m920187.あっ、私も行きます！\n癒し手の皆さんもお願いしますー！:
Ah, I'm coming too!
Healers, please come along as well!
m920187.あとは王子がゴルゴーンを討つまで、\n私たちが戦線を維持するだけですね。\n大丈:
All that's left is for the Prince to defeat Gorgon,
and for us to hold the line until then.
It'll be fine. You can definitely do it, Senior.
m920187.あなたが優しい神さまだってこと、\n竜の民にあなたが預けてくれたこの剣が、\n輝:
The fact that you are a kind god,
and that you entrusted this sword to the dragon people,
the Radiant Sword Claw Solas has told me!
m920187.あなたに勝って、\nあなたを救うために、あたしは戦います。\n亜神トラムが信じた:
To defeat you,
and to save you, I will fight.
As a descendant of the dragons that the Demigod Tram believed in!
m920187.あなたの指揮に合わせて、その力を解放するわ。\nグングニルの力と、私の力をあわせ:
I'll release that power in sync with your commands.
If we combine the power of Gungnir with mine,
we should be able to pierce even the demigod Gorgon.
m920187.あなたを信じる神器の担い手達が力を注いだ、\n勝利へ導き、答えをもたらす、\n神:
The bearer of this divine artifact, who believes in you, has poured their strength into it.
It is a spear woven to crush the divine, to guide you to victory, and to bring the answer.
Gungnir.
m920187.あの御方の采配ダ。\n創造主亡き天使は全テ、あの御方のものなのダから。:
It is that person's command.
All angels, with their Creator gone,
belong to that person.
m920187.あれは……オリュンポス……？\n天界に古くから存在する、\n世界を生み出すための:
That is…… Olympus……?
It is said to be a primordial testing ground that has existed in the Celestial Realm since ancient times,
created for the purpose of generating worlds.
m920187.いいんですのよ。\nさぁ傷を手当しませんと！:
It's all right.
Now, let me tend to your wounds!
m920187.いつか、我輩の記憶が戻ったその時に、\n酒でも酌み交わしながら\n真実を教えても:
Once my memories return,
we can share a drink
and you can tell me the truth then.
m920187.いつもどおりだ、皆。\n俺たちはもう、何も奪わせない。\nこの包囲を切り抜け、亜:
It's just like always, everyone.
We will not let them take anything else from us.
We will break through this siege and slay the Demigod Gorgon.
m920187.いや待て、後方からも敵が来ているぞッ！\nガオーッ！！ これは包囲されているなッ:
Wait, hold on! Enemies are coming from behind too!!
GAOHH!! We're being surrounded!!
m920187.うっ……ここは……。\nいったい何がおきて……。:
Ugh… Where am I…?
What on earth is happening…?
m920187.うっ……でもこの魔力の乱れ方はまずいです。\nピラミッドへ向かっているこれは、\:
Ugh……. But this magical disturbance is worrying.
What's heading toward the pyramid is
definitely the Holy Knights' second wave.
m920187.うむ。邪教に鉄槌を！\n戦闘の時は近い、皆、気を引き締めよ！:
Aye. Let the hammer fall upon the heretics!
Battle is near, everyone, stay alert!
m920187.うるせェ！！ 喚く前に手を動かセ！！\n勝利を盗ムのがテメェの仕事ダロ！！:
Shut up!! Get moving before you start whining!!
Stealing victory is your job, isn't it?!
m920187.うわぁぁぁぁぁんっ！！\n銀腕さまぁっ、トラムさまぁ！！\nよかったぁ、ご無事で:
Waaaaah!!
Silver Arm-sama, Tram-sama!!
I'm so glad you're safe, I'm really so glad!!
m920187.うん、だから俺たちの――じゃなかった。\nツキコの手をとって……？:
Yeah, so our―― no, that's not right.
Hold Tsukiko's hand……?
m920187.うーん、たしかに……。\nまさか砕いて打ち直すというわけにもいかないよね。:
Hmm, that's true……. 
We can't exactly smash it and reforge it, right?
m920187.えぇ、真に正しき者がどちらなのか、\nしっかりと見極めるとしましょう。:
Yes, let us carefully discern
who is truly on the right side.
m920187.えぇ、私は決して裏切らないわ。\n全力で王子を迎え撃つ。:
Yes, I will never betray you.
I will give the Prince my all in battle.
m920187.えぇ。決戦の後、\nこうしてピラミッドに再封印していたんです。:
Yes. After the battle, 
we re-sealed it in the pyramid like this.
m920187.おぉ、やはりそうか！\nかつては巨悪を砕くために、\nそして此度は皆を守るために:
Oh, so it is!
Once, we fought to shatter great evil,
and now, let us fight together to protect everyone!
m920187.おお、聞こえるぞ、星の声がッ！！\n先代より受け継ぎし、栄光ある軍団の名を叫べと:
Hah! I hear the voices of the stars!!
Let us shout the name of the glorious legion
inherited from our predecessors!!
m920187.おや、正しい型が崩れていないと良いのですが……。\n――なんて、軽口を叩けるのも:
Oh, I do hope he hasn't lost his proper form…….
――Though, I suppose I can only joke about that much.
m920187.お前か！ お前が僕の主をぉぉッ！！\n殺すっ、殺す殺す殺すぅぅぅぅっ！！:
It's you! You killed my master, you o-o-o-!!
Kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill,
m920187.かっこいいこと、言ってるけど……。\n勝つのはぼくたちだよ……。:
You're saying such cool things, but…….
We're the ones who will win…….
m920187.きっと、嗚呼、きっとそうだ。\n我輩は確かに、王子と肩を並べて戦った。\nこの場:
Of course, ah, it must be so.
I definitely fought shoulder to shoulder with the Prince.
Here, in this desert nation, we fought for justice.
m920187.きっと記憶を失う前の我輩が、\n何かしでかしたのだろう。しかし我輩とて、\n守る:
Myself, before I lost my memory,
must have done something to earn that reputation. But I, too,
am prepared to take up my sword and fight to protect what needs protecting!
m920187.くっ……それにデーモンとアンデッドにも、\n例の戦力を削ぐ祈りの効果を広げたよう:
Ugh…… and it seems the Demons and Undead
have extended the effect of that prayer that weakens enemy forces.
m920187.くっ……どうにか最初の攻勢はしのいだが、\nこれじゃキリがないぞ！:
Grrr…… We managed to weather the initial assault,
but this is never going to end!
m920187.くっ……撤退、撤退だ！\n全軍撤退せよ！！:
Grrr…… Fall back, all of you!
The entire army, retreat!!
m920187.こ、こっちは物質界連合軍ですよ……？\n軍を相手に、足止めの部隊を出してくるでし:
B-but we're the Material Realm Coalition……?
Would they send a holding force against a military unit?
m920187.この聖槍は魔力が尽きたせいでねー、\n本来持っていた「担い手に合わせた変形」が\:
Because this holy spear has run out of magic,
it can no longer perform its original function of
“reshaping itself to fit the wielder.”
m920187.これから先の戦いは、\nきっとより苛烈なものになります。\nけれど、王子が諦めな:
The battles ahead will surely be far more brutal.
But as long as you don't give up, Prince――
m920187.これから先の長い歴史に、\n千年に渡る平和をもたらすための戦いです。\n王子の言:
It is a war to bring a thousand years of peace
to the long history that lies ahead.
I'm just repeating the Prince's words, though.
m920187.これくらいで死にません！\nネズミに比べれば、連中など羽虫も同然です！:
I'm not dying over something like this!
Compared to rats, those things are nothing but flies!
m920187.これより、銀なる腕は人類と共にある。\nもう誰も見捨てない、私自身も諦めない。\:
From this moment on, the Silver Arm shall stand with humanity.
I will not abandon anyone, not even myself.
Prince, use my power!!
m920187.これ程までに物質界を愛してくれたあなたを、\n民のために犠牲になろうとするあなた:
I cannot destroy someone who loves the Material Realm so deeply,
someone willing to sacrifice themselves for their people,
someone who shares the same ideals as we do.
m920187.さぁ、トドメを刺しなさい。\n私が滅びれば「契約」は無効になる。\nもう、ゴルゴ:
Now, deliver the final blow.
If I perish, the "Contract" will be void.
The Gorgons will no longer be able to touch my people.
m920187.さぁ、人の身でどこまで戦えるのか、\nこの先に待つ戦いのため、見極めさせてもらお: Come now, let's see how far a mortal can fight. I'll judge you for the battles that lie ahead.
m920187.さぁ、行くがいい。\n人の身に余る願いを持つ者よ。\n今だけは天使として、お前た:
Now, go.
You who harbor wishes beyond mortal capacity.
For now, I shall bless you as angels.
m920187.さすがに天界も、\n「神殺しの聖槍」までは看過してくれないか。:
It seems the Heavenly Realm can't simply look the other way
when it comes to a “god-slaying holy spear.”
m920187.さっそく、宣戦布告されたということですね。\nいえ、事実上の鎖国宣言でしょうか？:
So they have declared war on us right away.
No, it is more like a declaration of a closed country, isn't it?
m920187.さらには！ 驚くなかレ！\n我らゴブリン族が、\n天界にすら進軍スル日が来たノダ:
And more! Don't be surprised!
The day has come when our Goblin race
will march even into the Celestial Realm!!
m920187.しかし、お前は……いや、そうだな。\n守るために剣を取る、それが本来のお前の姿だ:
But you are…… no, that's right.
Taking up your sword to protect others—that is who you truly are.
m920187.しかし、新たな仲間も増えました。\n私たちは確実に、\n未来を勝ち取るための道を:
However, we have gained new allies.
We are steadily walking the path
toward securing our future.
m920187.しかしその前に、\nこの地を占領しているゴルゴーンの軍が、\nこちらの足止めに現:
However, before that,
it is more likely that the Gorgon forces occupying this area
will appear to hold us up.
m920187.じゅ、準備だと……？\nいったい何の話だ？\nそれよりお前は、王国に与したのでは:
R-ready?
What are you talking about?
Besides, didn't you pledge yourself to the kingdom?
m920187.す、すごいっ、すごいですっ！\n手を繋いだだけなのに、\nグングニルが「契約」の:
W-wow, that's amazing! Amazing!
Just by holding hands,
Gungnir destroyed the "Contract's" magical power!?
m920187.す、捨て駒ということですか！？: D-does that mean they'll use them as expendable pawns?!
m920187.そう、だな。\nもとより逆境には慣れている。\n王子、皆と共に走れ！！:
Yes, that's right.
We're used to adversity anyway.
Prince, run with us all!!
m920187.そういうことー。\nよぉし、それじゃあ張り切って打ち直し――:
That's right!
Alright, let's get started on the reshaping——
m920187.そうだユージェン、魔王城の時みたいに、\n今回の戦いに何か名前は付けてないのか？:
That's right, Yuugen. Just like with the Demon King's castle,
haven't you given this battle a name?
Write it down for the poets of the future.
m920187.そうですね、私たちは\n次の時代に平和な世界を残すために、\nどんな敵とだって戦:
Yes, we must be prepared to fight any enemy
to leave a peaceful world for the next era.
m920187.そうよ！\n私たちは白の皇帝をぼっこぼこにして、\n正統なる王家の血脈を取り戻す:
That's right!
We're going to beat the White Emperor to a pulp
and restore the legitimate royal bloodline!
m920187.そして！ とうとう宿敵タル王子までモ！\n我らに助力を求めてくるに至っタのでアル:
And! Even our arch-nemesis, the Prince, has finally
come to seek our help, yo!!
m920187.そのオリュンポスとやらの周囲が、\n光の壁で覆われていくぞ……？:
The area around that Olympus thing
is being covered by a wall of light……?
m920187.その意気やヨシ！\n総員整列！ 去年を超えル行進を見せるノダ！！:
That's the spirit!
Everyone, fall in! Show me a march that surpasses last year's!!
m920187.その賭けは成立しないのでは？\n皆、王子のことを信じているのですから。:
That bet can't stand, can it?
We all believe in the Prince.
m920187.それで、私は何をしたらいいの？\nさすがに鍛冶は専門外なのだけれど……。:
And what am I supposed to do? 
Blacksmithing is certainly outside my expertise, but…….
m920187.それでは、我々は東側の街道に陣を構えましょう。: Then we shall set up camp on the eastern road.
m920187.それではやはり、防衛戦が必須ですね。\n王国、砂漠の国、暗黒騎士団で、\n三方向:
Then a defensive battle is indeed necessary. 
Let's have the Kingdom, the Desert Nation, and the Dark Knights 
cover three directions.
m920187.それでは我輩は自分の陣へ戻るぞ！\n背中は我ら暗黒騎士団が守護する。\n安心して:
Now, I'll return to my own camp!
The Dark Knights will guard your back.
Face the enemy ahead with peace of mind, Prince!!
m920187.それにあちらには、さっきの異端審問官もいます！\n獣人さんに、竜人さんに――:
And that heretic inquisitor is there too!
Beastkin, Dragonkin――
m920187.それにしても、出撃直前まで訓練なんて、\nゴブリン族ってすごい種族だね。:
Still, training right up until departure……
The Goblins are quite a remarkable race, aren't they?
m920187.それは心強い。\nさすがは聖槍の守護者殿だ！:
That's reassuring.
Truly worthy of the Guardian of the Holy Spear!
m920187.たー？ 今なにか聞こえたような……？: Yaaah? Did I just hear something…?
m920187.だから、だから真正面から打ち破る！\n孤独を選んだ私は正しかったと証明するために:
That's why I'll shatter you head-on!
To prove that I was right to choose solitude!
m920187.だから、導いてきました。\n誰にも「助けて」と言えなかったあなたのもとへ、\n物:
So, I have been guiding.
To you, who could not say "help me" to anyone,
I brought the strongest, most kind-hearted fool in the Material World.
m920187.だから勝ちましょう。\n王子になら、それができるはずです！:
That's why we have to win.
You can do it, Prince!
--- scene: The Battle of Those Who Refuse to Give Up (battle, battle) ---
m920187.だが、こいつは違う。\n民を、国を捨てて逃げたクソ野郎だが、\nその後、全てを取:
But this one is different.
He's a bastard who abandoned his people and his country to flee,
but he kept fighting to take everything back.
m920187.だが、嗚呼、そうだな……。\n為政者とはそういうものか。\n我が主も、民のために:
But, ah, I see…….
So that is what a ruler is.
My Master, too, was one who sacrificed himself for his people.
m920187.だが、真に国を愛するなら、\n容易くドッペルゲンガーなどに操られるな。\n……先:
But if you truly love this nation,
do not let yourself be so easily manipulated by such creatures as Doppelgangers.
…Especially since you share the same bloodline as the late Emperor.
m920187.だが奴らを殺し、神の楔を勝ち取れば、\nお前の主の復活も夢ではあるまい。: But if we slay them and claim the divine wedge, your master's revival won't be a dream.
m920187.だけど悪くない、って顔してるぜ。\nとはいえここからが本番か……。:
But you're wearing a smile, aren't you?
Still, the real battle is just beginning……
m920187.ちっ……こいつ精神支配に強すぎるぞ。\nどれだけ自尊心が高いんだ……。:
Tch…… This one's too resistant to mental domination.
How high is his self-esteem, exactly…….
m920187.ですから王子、これからも戦い続けましょう。\n助けを求める人のすべてに手を差し伸:
So, Prince, let us keep fighting.
Let us reach out to everyone who calls for help,
and charge forward as far as we can, just as we always have.
m920187.ですが、聖槍グングニルの能力を解放すれば、\nあのトラムの力に抗うこともできるか:
However, if we unleash the full power of the Holy Lance Gungnir,
we might be able to stand against her strength.
m920187.ですがまずは、此度の戦いのねぎらいを。\n天界への遠征、お疲れさまでした！:
But first, let us acknowledge your efforts in this battle.
Well done on the expedition to the Heavens!
m920187.でも、飛んでるから撃ちやすい……かな。\n聖槍の完成まであと少し、まだまだ戦える:
But since they're flying, they're easier to shoot… I think.
We're almost done completing the Holy Spear, so we can keep fighting!
m920187.でもこれ、本当にまずいですよ。\n砂漠の国に来ている部隊はそんなに多くないですし:
But this is really bad.
There aren't that many troops in this desert nation,
and if we're attacked from all directions, we won't be able to protect the blacksmith.
m920187.でもまさか、本物の「神殺しの聖槍」を、\n私たちが打ち直す日が来るなんてね。:
But I never imagined 
we'd be the ones reforging the real "God-Slaying Holy Lance."
m920187.でもデーモンやアンデッドの子は、\nその治癒効果を得られないっていうんでしょ？\:
But I've heard that Demons and Undead
can't benefit from that healing effect, right?
I've gotten the point, I really have!
m920187.でも！ もう！ そろそろ！ 限界だよ！\n迎撃部隊は全員ピラミッドの外にいたんだ:
But! We're! Almost! At our limit!
The entire interception force was outside the pyramid!
m920187.ところで、王子は聖槍によって、\n亜神の不死性を砕くという術を、\nいったい誰か:
By the way, Prince, who taught you
the technique to shatter a demigod's immortality
using the Holy Spear?
m920187.どうして私を見逃したの。\n答えて、人類の王子。:
Why did you let me go?
Answer me, Prince of Humanity.
m920187.どれだけ綺麗事を並べたって変わらない。\nこれからするのは、ただの殺し合いなのだ:
Prince, everyone is waiting for your command.
Believe that this battle leads to the future of the Material World.
m920187.なぜ……なぜ殺さないの。\nグングニルがあれば、神を滅ぼすこともできるのに。:
Why…… why don't you kill me?
With Gungnir, you could even destroy a god.
m920187.なっ……おじさま！\nいつも名前を付けているわけでは……！\n……まぁ、こっそり:
W-What…… Uncle!
I don't always name things……!
……Well, I did give it a name, quietly…….
m920187.なっ……ドゥマルデ審問官！\n邪教の徒を見過ごせと！？:
W-what…… Inquisitor Domalde!
Are you telling us to let the heretics escape!?
m920187.なっ……今はほぼ全軍がピラミッドの外なのに！: Wha…… Most of the army is outside the pyramid right now!
m920187.ならば良い。\n王子には嘘をつかせたくないし、\n辛い真実を言葉にさせたくもない:
Then that's fine.
I don't want you to lie to me,
and I don't want to force you to put a painful truth into words.
m920187.なるほど、これまで各国との友好を結んできた\n王子にしかできない、\n物質界の魔:
I see. A plan to unite all the demon swords of the Material Realm,
something only the Prince, who has forged alliances with every nation,
could pull off.
m920187.なんだ、もしかして緊張しているのか？\n肩の力を抜け、お前の腕は確かなんだからな:
What's wrong? Are you nervous? 
Relax. Your skills are reliable, after all.
m920187.はぁ、みんなやせ我慢大好きだよねー。\n――って、あれ？\n突然空が曇ってきたよ:
Haa, you guys really love to tough it out, don't you?
――Wait, what?
It feels like the sky is suddenly getting cloudy…….
m920187.はぁ～、トラムさまだぁ♪\nトラムさまがご無事だったよぉ♪:
Haa~, Lady Tram~♪
Lady Tram is safe~♪
m920187.はは、面白い賭けですな。\n無論聖槍の完成が先の方に賭けますぞ。:
Haha, that's an interesting bet.
Naturally, I'll bet on the Holy Spear being completed first.
m920187.ふぅ……ピラミッド内部に侵入した\n神聖騎士団は、どうにか排除できましたね。:
Phew……. We managed to drive out the Holy Knights
who had infiltrated the interior of the pyramid.
m920187.ふふ、ふふふ……。\nやっと、やっとミスリアちゃんの出番……！\n超専門分野だか:
Heh, hehehe……. 
Finally, finally, it's Mithria-chan's turn……! 
It's a super specialized field, so I really hope you can leave it to me!
m920187.まぁ、ドッペルゲンガーはそういう魔物ですから。\n――っと、ベラート伯爵が目を覚:
Well, that's just how Doppelgangers are.
――Oh, it seems Count Beradt is waking up.
m920187.まぁいい。これで十分だ。\nさっそく白の帝国に、支配したこいつ\n――パーフェク:
Well, it's enough.
Let's unleash this one we've dominated
――Perfect Beradt―― on the White Empire!
m920187.まだ先……？\nどういう――まさか、天使を呼んだの！？:
Still far off……?
What do you――could it be, you called the angels!?
m920187.みんな、みんなあの人みたいなことを……。\nどうして英雄王みたいなことを……言う:
No matter how many pretty words you string together, it won't change.
What happens next is just a slaughter!
m920187.むっ、うむ、そのとおりだ。\n我々は真に帝国の未来を憂いて……。:
Mm, yes, that's right.
We are truly concerned about the empire's future…….
m920187.もう、悔いはない。\n迷いも、ためらいも。:
I have no regrets anymore.
No more hesitation, no more doubt.
m920187.やれやれ、どうして皆、\n我輩を戦場から遠ざけたがるのだ。\n我輩も物質界連合軍:
Oh, dear. Why is it everyone
wants to keep me away from the battlefield.
I am a member of the Material Realm Coalition, am I not?
m920187.ようやく来たか、ゴルゴーン軍め。\n兵に恨みはないが、蹴散らすとしようぜ！:
So the Gorgon army has finally arrived.
I hold no grudge against the soldiers,
but I'll kick them all to the curb!
m920187.わ、妾の身体が……魂が……砕ける……ダト……！？: My, my body…… my soul…… is shattering……!?
m920187.ん、どうした王子、緊張しているのか？: Hm? What's wrong, Prince? Are you nervous?
m920187.んあー。\nこれから作業だっていうのに、\nどうして神聖騎士団とか現れるかなー。:
Ahhh. 
With work about to start, 
why do the Holy Knights have to show up?
m920187.んん……えぇと、どういうこと……？\nアラエルさまは？ 銀腕さまは？\nさっきま:
Mmm…… I mean, what's going on……?
Where is Arael-sama? And the Silver Arm……?
I feel like we were just together a moment ago…….
m920187.アラエル……そうだな、\n己が創造主の滅びなど、誰も信じたくはあるまい。: Arael… indeed, no one wants to believe that their creator could fall.
m920187.アラエルさまに……勝利を……。\nぼくたちを虐める王子に、敗北を……！:
For Arael-sama…… victory…….
And defeat for the Prince who torments us……!
m920187.アージェ、トラムの街までは、\nあとどれくらいだ？: Arge, how much further is it to the city of Tram?
m920187.アージェまで！？\nも、もうっ、亜神にも威厳というものが必要なのよ！？:
Even Arge!?
Oh, for heaven's sake, don't demigods need a shred of dignity!?
m920187.ウムウム。パタパタしている割に\n良い心がけではナイか！:
Mm-hm. For someone who flaps around so much,
that's a fine attitude!
m920187.オーッホッホッホ！\nその日を楽しみにしているわ。\nさぁ進みなさい、人間の王子:
Ohoho!
I look forward to that day.
Now, move along, human Prince!
m920187.ガオーッ！！ 武者震いというやつだなッ！！\nこの先に待つのは名高き亜神ッ！\n:
GAOOOH!! It's the thrill of battle!!
A renowned Subgod awaits us ahead!
In the future, this battle will be spoken of in legend!!
m920187.キャラットさんに、シビラさん？\nそれにミスリアさんも……。\nいったいどうした:
Carat, and Sybilla? 
And Mithria too……. 
What's going on?
m920187.クンレン！ クンレン！\nマイニチクンレン！！:
Training! Training!
Training every single day!!
m920187.グングニルの担い手め……ッ！\nこんな力を物質界に残しテいタのか……！！:
You, bearer of Gungnir……!!
You left power like this in the Material World……!!
m920187.グングニルの担い手を、ゴルゴーンのもとへ送り込む。\nそれが我輩たちの唯一にして:
Delivering the bearer of Gungnir to Gorgon…
That is our sole and most critical mission, is it not?
Then there is only one course of action to take.
m920187.ケッ、もう少し遅くても良かったんだゼ？\nだが、テメェがいないとシマラねぇからナ:
Tch, you could have taken a little longer, you know?
But we can't hold the line without you.
m920187.ケラウノス様を倒した実績があるからこそ、\n不死身の亜神を倒すにはうってつけって:
Since it has a track record of defeating Keraunos, 
it's perfect for defeating an immortal Lesser God. 
……But how do you reforge something this big?
m920187.ゴブリンバンザイ！\nメカゴブリンクイーン様！ バンザイ！:
Long live the Goblins!
Long live Mech Goblin Queen!
m920187.ゴブリン族は弱いと７年間デ思い知ったからナ、\nゆえに常に努力を怠ってはならない:
We've spent seven years proving that Goblins are weak,
so we must never neglect our efforts.
Knowledge and daily training are what save you in a pinch, you know.
m920187.ゴブリン軍団、獣王の民、深海の民、\nそして我ら暗黒騎士団の全戦力にかけて、\n:
By the Goblin Legion, the Beast King's people, the Deep Sea people,
and the full strength of our Dark Knights,
we shall not let a single soul pass this point!!
m920187.ゴルゴーンに勝てば、その「契約」は無効になるはず。\nあなたまで滅ぶ必要はないで:
If the Prince defeats Gorgon, that "contract" should become void.
There's no need for you to be destroyed too, is there……?
m920187.ゴルゴーンは麻痺の力を持っていたが、\n長く浴び続ければ石となるというのは、\n:
The Gorgons possessed the power of paralysis,
but to become stone from prolonged exposure……
So that is what it truly meant…….
m920187.ゴルゴーン様を滅ぼすか、否か。\nそれがお前たちの運命を変えることになる。:
Whether you will destroy Gorgon or not.
That choice will change your fate.
m920187.ダが、ここで消滅するわけにはいかない……。\nせめて妾の内、\n一欠片ダけデも…:
But I cannot simply vanish here……
At the very least, a single fragment of my being……
must reach that one……
m920187.デシウス！\nお前にはあの村の防衛を頼んでいたと思ったが……。:
Decius!
I thought you were assigned to defend that village…….
m920187.トラム！ いつまで意地を張っているんですか！\nあなたが結ばされた「契約」は、\:
Tram! How long will you keep being stubborn!
The "contract" you are bound by
is one not to betray Gorgon, isn't it?
m920187.ドゥマルデ審問官、どうしたのだ？\nこれは邪教を粛清するための戦いだぞ。\n異端:
Inquisitor Domalde, what's the matter?
This is a battle to purge the heresy.
It is your turn to step up as the Inquisitor.
m920187.ドゥマルデ審問官！\n神が、我らが主が！ 天使を遣わせてくれたぞ！！:
Inquisitor Domalde!
The gods, our lord! They have sent angels to aid us!!
m920187.ネフティ、まだ生きているか！？\nもう少しだ、あと少しで王子が来る！:
Nephty, are you still alive?!
Hold on a little longer. The Prince will be here soon!
m920187.パリオス、公の場ではしっかりなさい。\n私たちは天界代表でここに来ているのよ？:
Pallios, keep a better grip on yourself in public.
We are here as representatives of the Heavens, after all.
m920187.パリオスさん、あなたは操られていたんです。\n亜神ゴルゴーンの手によって。:
Pallios, you were being controlled.
By the sub-god Gorgon.
m920187.パリオス！ 正気に戻ったのか！？: Pallios! Are you back to your senses!?
m920187.パリオス！？ あっ、だ、だめよ！？\nこんな人前で抱きついたりしてはっ！:
Pallios!? Ah, n-no, stop it!?
Don't cling to me in front of everyone!
m920187.パーフェクトベラート、脱出モード！！\n我が伯爵たる威容を、\n取り残されし市民:
Perfect Beradt, escape mode!
I will show my true dignity as a Count
to the citizens left behind!
m920187.フシュシュ……。\n「契約」を忘れぬようにな、亜神トラムよ。:
Fushushu…….
Do not forget the "contract," demigod Tram.
m920187.フシュシュ……。\n所詮は心弱き者ダッタか……。:
Fushushu…….
So, in the end, you were a weak-willed one…….
m920187.フシュシュ……。その言葉を信じよう。\nダが、貴様の出番はまダ先ダ……。:
Fushushu……. I shall believe your words.
However, your turn is still far off…….
m920187.フシュシュ！\n天使如きが傷ツけられるような方ではない。\n三女神に力を分かタれ:
Fushushu!
That person is not one who can be harmed by angels.
Even after sharing power with the Three Goddesses,
that radiance remains undimmed.
m920187.フッ……お前が言うのか、ディアナ。\n強い者が帝国を治める、\nそれが帝国が強く:
Hmph… And you would say that, Diana?
The strong rule the empire.
Is that not the rule that keeps it strong?
m920187.フッ……ならば取るべき道はひとつだけだ。\n王子、俺はあちらの敵をやる。\nお前: Hmph… Then there's only one path to take. Prince, I'll deal with the enemies over there. You should cut straight through from the front.
m920187.ベラート伯爵、これまでよく戦ってくれました。\nここからは共に、帝国のために手を:
Count Beradt, you have fought well up to this point.
From here on, let us join hands for the empire.
m920187.ベルナ、気を抜かないで。\n次の部隊が上空の門から出てくるはず。:
Berna, don't let your guard down.
The next wave should be coming through the gate in the sky.
m920187.マスター、この地域でも天界の結界は有効です。\n攻撃行動の抑止、傷の自然治癒の効:
Master, the Celestial Realm's barrier is active in this area.
I can confirm effects suppressing enemy attacks and promoting natural healing.
m920187.マスター、気をつけてください。\nトラムは本気です。\n以前のような迷いが感じら:
Master, be careful.
Tram is serious.
I don't sense any of that hesitation from before.
m920187.ミスリアさん、聖槍の打ち直しには、\nどれくらい時間がかかりそうですか？: Mithria, how long do you expect the reforging of the Holy Lance will take?
m920187.ムッ、パリオスとやら、伝令ご苦労でアル。\nクククク、ようやくゴブリン軍団による:
Mm, you there, Pallios. Thank you for the message.
Kukuku, the beginning of the Goblin Legion's
conquest of the Celestial Realm is finally here!!
m920187.亜神ゴルゴーンの魔力、急速に低下していきます。\nわ、私たちの勝利ですよ！ やり:
The demigod Gorgon's magical power is dropping rapidly.
W-we're winning! We did it!!
m920187.亜神ゴルゴーンを討ったという事実は、\nすぐに天界中に知れ渡るはずです。:
The fact that we defeated the demigod Gorgon
will spread throughout the Celestial Realm in no time.
m920187.今はただ、己が信じるもののために\n泥を啜り、かの亜神に従うのだ。: For now, drink the mud for the sake of what you believe in and obey that demigod.
m920187.今回の工程は大きく分けてふたーつ！\n「魔力の充填」と「人が扱える形への打ち直し:
This process basically breaks down into two big steps!
“Charging the magic” and “reshaping it so a person can actually wield it”!
Princess, I'm counting on you for that first step of charging the magic!
m920187.何が敵であろうと、俺たちは勝利する。\n自分たちの行く末を、自ら決めるために。:
No matter who our enemy is, we will win.
So that we may decide our own destiny.
m920187.何をご冗談を。\n我らは帝国に忠誠を誓った身ではありませんか。:
What a joke.
Aren't we the ones who swore loyalty to the empire?
m920187.余計に緊張させてどうするんだ！\nはぁ……まったく。:
How does that help my nerves?!
Haa… Honestly.
m920187.俺たちの目指す先は、きっと同じだ。\n俺はもう、誰にも負けるつもりはない。\n物:
The destination we seek is surely the same.
I have no intention of losing to anyone anymore.
I will not abandon the Material Realm, nor the Celestial Realm.
m920187.俺たちの？ ん？ 今何か変なことを――: Our? Hm? Did I just say something――
m920187.入ってくるなって意味か、\nここを超えたら殺すって意味か――:
Does it mean “don't come in,”
or does it mean “cross this line and you die”――
m920187.全軍怯むな！\n我らが主の言葉を信じよ！:
Do not tremble, all of you!
Believe in the words of our master!
m920187.冗談言ってる場合カァ！？\n畜生ッ、王子、早く、早く来やがレェ！！:
Is this the time for jokes?!
Damn it, Prince, hurry up and get here!!
m920187.前にも一度、この砂漠で、\n王子と共闘し、強大な敵に挑んだことがあるような……。:
I feel as though, once before, in this very desert,
I fought alongside the Prince against a mighty foe……
m920187.千年戦争の折には物質界に味方し、\n神器まデ残しテきタ弱き亜神め。:
A weak demigod who sided with the Material World during the Millennium War,
and even left behind a Divine Artifact…….
m920187.各国のお姫さまが手伝ってくれてるから、\n予定よりも順調だけど、\n早く見積もっ:
The princesses from the various nations are helping out, 
so it's going more smoothly than planned, 
but even with a quick estimate, it'll be about half a day.
m920187.周辺都市国家からの報告だと、\n獣人と竜人の戦力を減少させる、\n祈りの言葉を使:
Reports from the surrounding city-states say
they're using words of prayer
to weaken the Beastfolk and Dragonkin forces.
m920187.嘘、ですよね……？\n愛剣とお友達のアージェさんまで、\n物質界のために捧げたあ:
That's a lie, right……?
You even gave up your beloved sword, Arge,
for the sake of the Material World…….
m920187.国を人質に取られた為政者……か。\n王子、貴様が同じ状況なら、どうする。:
A ruler held hostage by his own nation……
Prince, if you were in the same situation, what would you do?
m920187.堂々と領土を宣言してきたわけか。\n――だが、ここで止まるつもりはないんだろ？:
So they are boldly declaring their territory.
―But you're not planning to stop here, are you?
m920187.天使は神の兵器、だっけ？\n兵器だけあって無尽蔵ってわけか。:
Angels are weapons of the gods, right?
No wonder they seem endless.
m920187.天界と物質界では、軍の考え方が違うのですよ。\n我々にとって兵は仲間であっても、:
The Celestial Realm and the Material Realm have different military philosophies.
Soldiers may be comrades to us,
but that is not always the case from the perspective of the Subgods.
m920187.天界に危機が迫った時のため、\n人類にその力を貸しなさいと。\nそして、その未来:
In case of a crisis in the Heavens,
lend your power to humanity.
And guide that future.
m920187.威厳なんて演説する時だけでいいんですよぉ♪\nさぁて、都の住人の皆さんを救助しに:
Dignity is only needed during speeches, after all♪
Now then, let's go rescue the citizens of the capital!
m920187.彼らが「神」と称する者が、\n何かの力を与えたのでしょうか……。\n王子、警戒し:
Perhaps the one they call “god”
has granted them some kind of power…….
Prince, engage them while staying on guard!
m920187.後悔なら、もう十分したわ。\n私は最初から、あの時に、助けを求めるべきだった。:
I've regretted it enough already.
I should have asked for help from the very beginning, back then.
m920187.応ッ！ 我輩の姿を見よ！\nこれこそ民を守る、勇壮なる騎士の鎧姿だぞ！:
Aye! Behold my form!
This is the armor of a valiant knight, sworn to defend the people!
m920187.怪我をした方はこちらへ！\n応急手当ですが、絶対に死なせませんから！:
Those who are wounded, come this way!
It's only first aid, but I won't let anyone die!
m920187.想定通りですよ、この状況も。\n何しろこれは戦争ですから、\n軍の本拠地に乗り込:
This is within expectations, of course.
After all, this is a war.
If you storm the enemy's main base, this is what happens.
m920187.感心してる場合か！\n王子、砂漠の国側も善戦しているが、\n時間稼ぎがせいぜいだ:
Now is not the time for admiration!
Prince, the desert nation is holding their own,
but they can only buy us time. It won't last long.
m920187.我らゴブリン族は最弱にシテ最強ニ至る種族！\n決戦の直前マデ、訓練ヲ怠ることナカ:
We Goblins are a race that has reached the pinnacle of strength from the very bottom!
Do not slack off on training until the moment just before the decisive battle!!
m920187.敵だと……？\nネフティ、敵の編成は？ どこの手の者だ？:
Enemies……?
Nephty, what are their ranks? Who are they?
m920187.敵は肉体なき、白き鎧の軍勢だと聞く。\nならば鎧に魂を宿した先達として、\n我ら:
I hear the enemy is an army of soulless, white-armored knights.
Then, as one who has imbued souls into armor before,
I must face them head-on!
m920187.斥候からの報告よ。\n神聖騎士団には例の異端審問官もいるみたい。:
Report from the scouts.
It looks like the Holy Knights have that heretic inquisitor with them.
m920187.時間は稼いで――うぅん、盗んでおいたから。\nあとはあいつらを蹴散らすだけだよ！:
We bought some time―hmm, stole it, actually.
All we have to do now is crush them!
m920187.本当に、これで良いのですよね？\n人類が、天界に抗うことは、正しいのですよね？:
Is this truly the right path?
Is it right for humanity to defy the heavens?
m920187.本当に。\nけれど聖槍は守り抜きましたよ。:
Indeed.
But we managed to protect the Holy Spear.
m920187.次なる戦いに備えるのが我らのつとめ。\nここで命を落とし、\n真に必要な戦いに臨:
Preparing for the next battle is our duty.
Is it your faith that we should fall here
and fail to face the battle that truly matters?
m920187.油断するなよパリオス。\nまだ街への道が開けただけだ！:
Don't get cocky, Pallios.
We've only just opened a path to the city!
m920187.然り、然り。\n我らとて王子を迎え撃った折、\n手勢にて包囲を敷いたではないか。:
Indeed, indeed.
When we ambushed the Prince before,
did we not deploy our forces to encircle him?
m920187.王子、「神殺しの聖槍」なくして、\n亜神ゴルゴーンの不死性は貫けません。\n必ず:
Prince, without the "God-Slaying Holy Lance," 
we cannot pierce the immortality of the Lesser God Gorgon. 
We must protect the pyramid at all costs!
m920187.王子、ここからは連戦となるはずです。\n物質界を救うため、天界の民を解放するため: Prince, we're about to face back-to-back battles. To save the Material Realm and free the Celestial folk, please grant us victory on our path.
m920187.王子、これがあなたの、新たな力。\n立ちふさがる者を貫き砕く、神を殺す唯一の武器:
Prince, this is your new power.
The only weapon capable of piercing and shattering all who stand in your way—a weapon forged to slay gods.
m920187.王子、どうかしたの？\nもう敵陣のど真ん中だから、気を抜いちゃだめ。:
Prince, is something wrong?
We're right in the heart of the enemy lines, so don't let your guard down.
m920187.王子、グングニルの力を手にとってください。\n「神を討つ意志」の称号を担うことで:
Prince, please take hold of Gungnir's power.
By shouldering the title of "One Who Slays Gods,"
this power will become yours.
m920187.王子、天使たちが来ます！\nどうか、慎重な指揮をお願いします！: Prince, the angels are arriving! Please command them carefully!
m920187.王子、天使はピラミッドの上空から降下してくる。\nピラミッドの入り口を直接目指す:
Prince, the angels will descend from above the pyramid.
Some may head straight for the entrance.
Be careful with your troop placement!
m920187.王子、市街地への道は私たちが確保するわ。\n王国軍って防衛戦は苦手でしょう？:
Prince, we'll secure the route to the city center.
The Royal Army isn't very good at defensive battles, is it?
m920187.王子、戦闘準備を！\nこの戦いを制し、天界へ向かうために！:
Prince, prepare for battle!
To win this fight and advance toward the heavens!
--- scene: God-Slaying Spear Gungnir (battle, end) ---
m920187.王子、皆、あなたの指揮を待っています。\nこの戦いが、物質界の未来に繋がると信じ: Prince, everyone is waiting for your command, believing this battle will shape the future of the Material Realm.
m920187.王子、私の銀腕は時を経ることで\nその力を紡ぎあげる神器よ。:
Prince, my Silver Arm is a Divine Artifact
that weaves its power together over time.
m920187.王子ちゃんとは似ているようで、\nちょっと違いますね。:
He's similar to you, Prince,
in some ways, and different in others.
m920187.王子殿下、トラムさんが現れました！\n不死性を示す魔力が乱れています。\n聖槍グ:
Your Highness, Tram has appeared!
The magic radiating from her immortality is destabilizing.
The power of the Holy Lance Gungnir is taking effect!
m920187.白い鎧の騎士団……。\n間違いありません、神聖騎士団です！\n王子、急ぎ迎撃の準:
A knightly order in white armor…….
It's no mistake, they're the Holy Knights!
Prince, please prepare for an immediate counterattack!
--- scene: The Ruins Where the Holy Spear Slumbers, Once More (battle, end) ---
m920187.白の皇帝よ、私を見逃したことを後悔するがいい。\n貴様の在位によって涙を流した、:
White Emperor, you will regret sparing me.
The sorrow of every citizen who has wept under your rule
will only make me stronger.
m920187.真に天界を統べるべきあの御方を裏切り、\n物質界に味方するトいうのなら、\nその:
Betraying the One who truly should rule the Celestial Realm,
and siding with the Material World……
May you continue to regret that choice……!
m920187.砂漠の国の全軍に、王子の部隊……。\nせめてもうひとつ、同等の規模の部隊があれば:
The entire army of the desert nation, plus the Prince's forces…….
If we only had one more unit of comparable size…….
m920187.確かに気になり――って、あれ？\n何でしょうこの魔力の反応……。\nあっちの方角:
It certainly is concerning――wait, what?
What is this magical reaction…….
A powerful wave is coming from that direction――
m920187.神の武器ってすごいのね……。\n勝手に大きさが変わったりするの？:
Divine weapons are amazing…….
They change size on their own?
m920187.神や亜神からすれば、\n他の生物は自らの被造物ですからねぇ。\n所有物を壊して何:
To the Gods and Subgods,
other creatures are their creations, after all.
They'd probably say something like, "What's wrong with breaking your own property?"
m920187.神殺しの武器を打ち直すんだから、\n魔剣持ちと、魔剣専門の鍛冶職人が必須でしょ？:
If you're reforging a god-slaying weapon, 
you need a demon sword wielder and a blacksmith specializing in demon swords, right? 
So I brought them along!
m920187.神殺しの聖槍、その名もグングニル！！\n完成しましたー！！:
The God-slaying Holy Spear, named Gungnir!!
It's complete―!!
m920187.神討つ槍の担い手は、君しかいない。\nいつも綱渡りばかりですまないが、\n君の理:
You are the only one who can wield the spear that slays gods.
We may always be walking a tightrope, but we will guard the path to your ideals.
m920187.神話のとおりなら、だけどねー。\nだから各国の王家に伝わる魔剣――:
If the myths are to be believed, they do.
That's why the demon swords passed down through the royal families of each nation——
m920187.私たちが天界に\n侵略してきたと考える亜神もいることでしょう。:
There will surely be demigods who believe
we have come to invade the Celestial Realm.
m920187.私たちの歩む道を、世界の未来を、この槍で貫くの。\nあなたは負けないって誓ったん:
We will pierce through the path we walk and the future of the world with this spear.
You swore you would not lose, so
show us that resolve, that determination.
--- scene: God-Slaying Spear Gungnir (battle, start) ---
m920187.私たちは、王子の目指す未来を信じます。\nだからどうか、悔いなき戦いを。:
We believe in the future you strive for.
So please, fight a battle you will have no regrets about.
m920187.私には、できなかったこと。\n誰かに頼ることをせず、\nひとりで全部、成し遂げよ:
There were things I couldn't do.
Things I couldn't accomplish on my own,
without relying on anyone else.
m920187.私の間違いを、証明するために……ッ！！: To prove that I was wrong……!!
m920187.私は帝国を……取り戻すために……？\nくっ、頭が……頭が割れるように痛い……。:
I was trying to… reclaim the empire…?
Grrr… My head… it's splitting…
m920187.私もそうだった。千年戦争の折、\n女王であることを過信し、民を失った。:
I was the same. During the Millennium War,
I was overconfident in my status as Queen and lost my people.
m920187.聖槍の打ち直しが先か、\nこちらが倒れるのが先か、\nといったところですかな。さ:
It's a race between the reforging of the Holy Spear
and our own defeat.
I wonder which one I should bet on.
m920187.肉体が無いってのは便利ですねぇ。\n倒せど倒せど、次の部隊が出てくるとは。:
It is quite convenient not having a physical form, isn't it?
No matter how many we defeat, another unit just appears.
m920187.自分たちそっくりのドッペルゲンガーを倒すの、\n結構嫌な感じですね……。:
Defeating Doppelgangers that look exactly like us…
It's a rather unsettling feeling, isn't it?
m920187.自分を犠牲にするお人好しと、\nどんな死地にでも手を伸ばすお人好しですか。\n確:
A fool who sacrifices himself,
and a fool who reaches for any death trap.
Indeed, that sounds like good material for a legend.
m920187.観測――完了。\nあの壁は、天界の障壁に類似していますが、\nより強力な、攻勢防:
Observation――complete.
That wall resembles the Celestial Realm's barriers,
but it can be judged as a stronger, offensive defense wall.
m920187.言うようになったな。\nさぁ、天界に向かう準備をしろ。\n敵は国内ばかりではない:
You've certainly become bold.
Now then, prepare to head for the Heavens.
The enemy is not confined to our lands; they are in the sky, too.
m920187.計測――完了。\nこの行軍速度であれば、街まではあと少しです。:
Measurement――complete.
At this marching speed, we're not far from the city.
m920187.誰だって緊張しますよぉ……。\n目の前のこの巨大な槍こそ、かつて、\n女神ケラウ:
Anyone would be nervous……. 
This massive lance right in front of us is the Holy Lance 
that once defeated the Goddess Keraunos……!
m920187.飛んでる方が撃ちやすいっていうの、\nもう天才の域だと思うわ……。\n王子、魔導:
Thinking that flying targets are easier to hit…
That's practically genius territory…
Prince, the mage corps is intact. Give us the next order!
m920187.魔物の復活ヨリ、早７年！\nゴブリン族の躍進ハ留まるところを知らナイ！:
It's been seven years since the monsters' revival!
The Goblin race's rise has no limits, yo!
m920187.魔王が復活した時も、あなたたちが苦しんでいた時も、\n世界樹に神の楔が突き立てら:
When the Demon King was resurrected, when you were suffering,
even when the divine wedge was driven into the World Tree,
I fought solely to protect this city.
m920187.魔王ガリウス様は敗北シタ！\nだが、我らゴブリン族は未だ隆盛を誇ってイル！:
Demon King Garious was defeated!
But our Goblin race still basks in glory, yo!
m920187.（――あなたには、「契約」に縛られた私を、\n殺してもらわないといけないのだから:
(――You must be the one to kill me,
bound as I am by the "contract")
m920187.（――あの人になら「助けて」って、言えたのかしら）: (――Could I have said “help me” to that person?)
m920187.（――そう、いつの世も、\n王とは民のために己を殺すか、\n民を殺して己が生きる:
(――So, in every age,
a king is either one who sacrifices himself for his people,
or one who kills his people to survive)
m920187.（――その身を石に変えられし\n我が民よ、もう少しだけ待っていて）:
(――My people, turned to stone,
please wait just a little longer)
m920187.（……やはり神はいないのか？\n我らの信じた神は、死んだのか……？）:
(……So, the gods truly do not exist?
The gods we believed in…… are they dead……?)
m920187.（……王子、必ずここへたどり着いて。\n私と戦うその瞬間まで、必ず生き残って）:
(……Prince, you must reach this place.
You must survive until the very moment you fight me)
m920187.（いや、もしや神と信じていたものは、\n遠い昔に、もう神ではなくなっていたのか…:
(No, perhaps what we believed to be gods
ceased to be gods long, long ago……?)
m920187.（この様を見ればわかる。\n子孫たる王子も、きっとそうなんだ）:
(I can see it just by looking at this.
His descendant, the Prince, must be the same way.)
m920187.（だが、彼らを置いていくことはできない。\n信仰に身を捧げた被害者たる彼らに、\:
(But I cannot leave them behind.
I cannot force this cruel truth upon them,
victims who have devoted their lives to faith.)
m920187.（でも、あの人はどうだったかしら……。\n英雄王、私たちが信じて戦ったあの人は）:
(But what about that person…….
The Hero King, the one we believed in and fought for)
m920187.（ケラウノス、アイギス、アダマス……。\n三女神に力を分かたれたという我らが主よ:
(Keraunos, Aegis, Adamas……
Our lord, who supposedly shared his power with the Three Goddesses.
I can no longer believe in you, who harms the world.)
m920187.（主よ、信仰とは人を救うものではなかったのか……？）: (My lord, was faith not meant to save people……?)
m920187.（嗚呼、あとは私が「契約」を果たし、\nゴルゴーンと共に滅べば、\nこの都は石の:
(Ah, once I fulfill the "contract" and
perish alongside Gorgon,
this capital will be freed from the stone curse……)
m920187.（思い返せば、みんなそうだった。\n英雄王を慕って集まってきた者たちは、\nみん:
(Looking back, they were all like that.
Everyone who gathered around the Hero King
was nothing but a bunch of hopeless idealists.)
m920187.（我らは神に祈りを捧げ、\n正しき道を歩むことを旨としていたはず。\n――ゆえに:
(We were supposed to offer prayers to the gods
and walk the righteous path.
—Therefore, I must discern the true will of the gods.)
m920187.（王子が――あの人の子孫が、\n私を殺しに来てくれたわ。\nかつての私の剣の担い:
(The Prince has come――the descendant of that man,
to kill me.
He has brought the bearer of my former sword and my right-hand man with him.)
m920187.（異教の遺跡を、そして聖槍を破壊しろだと……？\nそれのどこが神のお告げだ、聖な:
(Destroy the heretical ruins, and the Holy Spear……?
How is that a divine command, or holy words?
It sounds like nothing more than the orders of an invading nation.)
m920187.（皆に愛され、支えられ、\nずっとまっすぐに突き進んでくる……そういう人）:
(Loved and supported by everyone,
charging straight ahead without a single doubt…… that kind of person.)
m920187.（神聖騎士団、全軍を動かせとは。\n我が主も随分と焦っているとみえる）:
(To mobilize the entire Holy Knight Order……
It seems my lord is quite desperate.)

m920208.……そういえば、神仙郷近くのとある山奥に、\nあらゆる穢れを祓う幻の温泉がありま:
……Speaking of which, deep in the mountains near the Immortal Realm,
there was a legendary hot spring said to purify all impurities.
m920208.……どうやら先約がいたようです。\n温泉がお猿さんに占拠されています。:
...It seems someone got here before us.
The hot spring is being occupied by monkeys.
m920208.……は？ あの、今なんと？: ...Huh? I'm sorry, what did you just say?
m920208.……仙薬湯の影響か、小人に力が漲ってますね。\n手早く倒さねば体力を回復されてし:
...Perhaps it's the influence of the Elixir Spring.
The dwarves seem to be brimming with strength.
We must defeat them quickly before they recover their stamina.
m920208.……大変申し訳ございません、シェフ。\n力及ばず、施設が壊されてしまいました。:
I am terribly sorry, Chef.
We were outmatched, and the facilities have been destroyed.
m920208.……練兵場と温泉か。\nいっそレストランでも併設するか？\n我々のノウハウも活か:
……A training ground and a hot spring.
Perhaps we should add a restaurant as well?
We could certainly put our expertise to good use.
m920208.……良いアイデア、だと思ったのだがな。\nオークの英雄を呼べばこうなるのも当然か:
I thought it was a good idea, though.
Of course this would happen if we called in the Orc hero.
Looking back, I must have been in a state of frenzy.
m920208.──ええっ！？ この温泉郷閉鎖されちゃうの！？: ──Eh?! So this hot spring resort is going to be closed down!?
m920208.──さあ、追い詰めたよ災厄の魔女！\n新年早々悪だくみは許さないんだから！:
──There! Nowhere to run, you witch of calamity!
I won't let you get away with your evil schemes right at the start of the new year!
m920208.──その話、詳しく聞かせてくれない？\nわたしたちもその温泉を探してるの、お願い:
...Could you tell us more about that?
We're looking for that hot spring too. Please!
m920208.──ということで、\n隠蔽の結界をより強化するために、\n温泉郷を一時閉鎖するこ:
So, to strengthen the concealment barrier,
we have decided to temporarily close the hot spring resort.
m920208.──へぇ！ そりゃすげぇ、\nそれじゃあその温泉に浸かったら、\n病気が全部治っ:
...Huh! So that's the amazing part, huh?
So if you soak in that hot spring,
all your illnesses just disappear?
m920208.──ッ、流石シェフ！ 名案ですね！\nであれば休憩室や遊戯場もどうでしょう？:
──! As expected of you, Chef! What a brilliant idea!
How about a lounge or a game room too?
m920208.──ッ！ 待ちなさい！ 何をする気ですか！？: ──Hey! Wait! What do you think you're doing!?
m920208.──世はまさに大温泉時代！: The age of great hot springs has arrived!
m920208.──手は尽くしたのだけど、残念ね。: I've done everything I can, but I'm afraid it's no use.
m920208.──沈んでいた悪意たちが、蠢動を始める前に。: —Before the malice that had been dormant begins to stir.
m920208.『ぼくは結界だけ解いて、\n温泉郷の管理を怠りました』: "I only lifted the barrier and neglected the management of the hot spring resort."
m920208.『戦わないと出られない温泉』だ。\n練兵場と温泉という二つの施設を掛け合わせ、\: A "Hot Spring You Can't Leave Without Fighting." It combines a training ground with a hot spring, allowing you to sweat it out immediately after your drills!
m920208.あ、ここに立て看板がありますよ！\nええと、ふむふむ……攻め力向上の湯？:
Oh, there's a signpost here!
Let's see... hmm, hmm... "Spring of Enhanced Attack Power"?
m920208.ああ、いえ、すみません。\n旅行気分でと言ったのは私でしたね、\n急かしたいわけ: Ah, I'm sorry. I was the one who suggested we take a vacation mood, and I didn't mean to rush you, but—
m920208.ああ、ただの温泉旅館を経営するのでは意味がない。\nデモシェフ商会独自の強みを持: Ah, merely running a standard hot spring inn would be pointless. We need a hot spring with a unique strength that only the Demon Chef Trading Company can offer.
m920208.ああっ、じれったい！ これでもくらいなっ！: Ah, this is so infuriating! Take this!
m920208.ああっ、なんだか命が二つある感じだ。\n今なら一回死んでも生き返る気がするぜ！:
Ahh, it feels like we have two lives' worth of vitality.
I feel like if I died right now, I'd come back to life!
m920208.ああっ！ マズゥが不味そうな薬を飲んで──: Ah! Mazu is drinking that nasty-looking potion—
m920208.ああっ！？ 忘れてたー！？: Ahh!? Did we forget about that!?
m920208.あたしは家に帰らせてもらうよ！\nこの仙薬湯は手土産に頂いとくね！:
I'm heading home!
I'm taking this elixir as a souvenir!
m920208.あたしゃ生まれた頃から天才魔術師、\n全盛期にゃ及ばずとも魔力は十分さね！\nあ:
I've been a genius sorceress since birth!
Even if I'm not at my peak, my magic power is more than enough!
Blowing you lot away is child's play for me!
m920208.あのマズゥという魔女だけであれば、\nそれほど大きな問題ではないのかもしれません:
If it were just that witch Mazu,
it might not be such a big deal.
But they maintain their own intelligence networks.
m920208.あはは、途中から完全に温泉旅行だったわー。: Ahaha, it completely turned into a hot spring trip partway through~.
m920208.あははははは！ 戻すわけがないじゃないか！\n魔術の発展のため、尊い犠牲になって:
Ahahaha! Why would I do that?
You're making a noble sacrifice for the advancement of magic!
m920208.ありがとおじさん、やっさしー！ 心がイケメン！:
Thanks, mister! You're so nice!
You're a total heartthrob!
m920208.あれ、もっと若返っちゃった？: Huh? Did she get even younger?
m920208.あれっ、なんとも……って、ええっ！？: What...? I don't feel anything... Wait, what?!
m920208.あれほどの威力の攻撃を受けたのです、\n以前であれば薬の効果も切れるはずですが…:
After taking an attack of that magnitude,
the effects of the medicine should have worn off by now, but…
m920208.あんまり甘く見ないでよね！\nこの身体でも戦闘の経験はあるんだから！:
Don't underestimate me!
Even in this body, I still have combat experience!
m920208.あー、やっぱりアタシたち、\nちょっとやらかしちゃった系？: Ah, so we really did mess things up, huh?
m920208.いい気味さね、小人の数に圧し潰されちまいな！: Serves you right! Let the dwarves crush you!
m920208.いえ、まずは彼らの蛮行を阻止せねばですね。: No, we must stop their rampage first.
m920208.いきなりどうなされましたシェフ。: What's with the sudden outburst, Chef?
m920208.いてててて……大人気ないやつらだね！\nこんな幼気な子供を虐めて楽しいかい！？:
Ow ow ow ow… you're all such brats!
Do you actually enjoy bullying a kid this young!?
m920208.いやいや、君たちのせいじゃないよ。\nどちらかと言えば、ぼくのせいかな……？:
No, no, it's not your fault.
If anyone is to blame, it's me……
m920208.いやなに、我々デモシェフ商会もそろそろ、\n温泉事業に手を出してみるべきだと思っ: Oh, nothing much. I've been thinking it's about time the Demon Chef Trading Company got into the hot spring business.
m920208.いろんな効能の温泉があるっぽいねー。\nこりゃ結構お目当て見つけるの大変かも？:
There are springs with all sorts of effects.
This might be pretty tough to find the right one!
m920208.うぅ……ごめんね、わたしが小さくなってなければ……。: Ugh... I'm sorry. If I hadn't gotten smaller...
m920208.うぅ、警戒されて入れないよぉ。: Ugh, they're on guard. I can't get in.
m920208.うっ、うん！ きっと大丈夫、だよね──？: Ugh, yeah! It'll be fine, right...?
m920208.うっかりと迷い込んじまったんだよ、\n事情も聴かずに攻撃なんて酷いじゃないか。\:
I simply got lost and wandered in by accident.
It's cruel to attack me without even hearing my side of the story.
I only picked the herbs because I was starving.
m920208.うっへぇ……変な色の薬ぃ。\nスライムみたいできもちわるー。\nあれ飲むの……？:
Ugh… that's some weird-colored potion.
Looks like slime. Gross.
Are you really going to drink that…? Seriously…?
m920208.うるさいね！\n軽そうな頭してるくせに、\n正論ばっか言わないでおくれ！:
Hush!
Don't spout such sensible nonsense, you empty-headed fool!
m920208.うんうん、体調の方は大丈夫そ？: Yeah, yeah, are you feeling okay?
m920208.うん！ 目指せ幻の温泉郷だね！: Yeah! Let's aim for the legendary hot spring!
m920208.ええ、過ぎた力は身を滅ぼします。\nましてやあらゆる呪いや病を癒す温泉など、\n:
Yes, excessive power leads to destruction.
Especially a hot spring that can heal any curse or illness.
If its existence became known to the world, it could become a seed of conflict.
m920208.ええい、あんまり舐めるんじゃないよ！: Don't you dare look down on me!
m920208.ええい、じゃあ二倍！ 二倍出そうじゃないか！: Tch, fine! I'll pay double! Double!
m920208.ええいっ、しつこい小娘だね！\nあたしが何をしたって言うんだい！:
Hmph, you persistent little brat!
